bbc2.uk.description: Series 3 Episode 4. A quiz show in which a team of four take on the `Bridge of Lies'. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and 10 lies, and they must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
bbc2.uk.description: Series 1 Episode 13: St George's Market. Colin Murray and Edith Bowman explore St George's Market in Belfast and meet a social media sensation who reveals the secrets of healthy and inexpensive one-pot meals. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
bbc2.uk.description: Series 1 Episode 9: Lairg to Caithness. Michael Portillo's coastal railway journey takes him past lochs and castles on the Far North Line to Britain's northernmost railway station at Thurso. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
bbc2.uk.description: Series 1 Episode 4. 300,000 square miles of ocean. Three GPS-tracked voyages, filmed around the clock. One week at sea. Crabber Tydus has had a terrible year, missing months of fishing due to breakdown. With the boat finally fixed, skipper Stiggy pushes the crew to work around the clock to fill the tank with ten tonnes of crab. After covering expenses, Stiggy gambles and moves his pots further south. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
bbc2.uk.description: Series 28 Episode 14: Lancaster. Michael Aspel and the team are in Lancaster, where items uncovered include a valuable pair of clogs, a moving series of letters from the Crimea, an anti-slavery ring, and a rare and intricately-woven tapestry. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Flog It!
bbc2.uk.description: Wiltshire 55. Claire Rawle and Michael Baggott discover an amethyst and pearl brooch and a set of Beatles signatures, and Paul visits London to unearth the hidden architectural gems of one of Wiltshire's most famous sons - Sir Christopher Wren. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: House of Games
bbc2.uk.description: Series 10 Episode 39: Week 8: Thursday. Every day this week, celebrity contestants Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
bbc2.uk.description: Series 24 Episode 39. Ellie Taylor is back with the latest news and behind-the-scenes action from the world of Strictly. Also, costume designer Vicky Gill has an exclusive look at what the couples will be wearing in Blackpool's Tower Ballroom. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbc2.uk.description: Series 21 : Somerset Borders (Extended Versions). Sonali Shah showcases some superb Somerset properties to a couple who have a budget of £700,000 and want a countryside home where they can upgrade an allotment to their very own back garden veggie patch. Sonali also learns about the potentially perilous Bristol Channel and meets the volunteers who operate two life-saving rescue hovercrafts. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Highland Cops
bbc2.uk.description: Series 4 Episode 4. Covering 12,000 square miles of breathtaking landscapes, from deep lochs and towering mountains to remote islands and glens, Police Scotland's Highlands and Islands division covers Britain's biggest beat. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
bbc2.uk.description: Series 1 Episode 3. Marco, Gordon and Heston reunite for the first time in decades. Will time have healed old wounds, or will old rivalries still burn brightly? (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Cunk on Cinema
bbc2.uk.description: Series 1 Episode 2. Philomena Cunk uncovers an age of screen icons from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, and incredible movies, from Taxi Driver to Jaws to Citizen Ken. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Newsnight
bbc2.uk.description: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: Past Lives
bbc2.uk.description: Drama (2023). Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrest apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Decades later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront destiny, love and the choices that make a life. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: See Hear
bbc2.uk.description: Series 44 Episode 16: Children in Need Special. Features and discussions reflect on the lives of individuals with various degrees of hearing impairments. Along the way, the presenters share their perspectives on relevant matters. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbc2.uk.description: Series 19 Episode 6. The standout chefs from the week's heats battle it out again in the quarter-final. The stakes are higher, the challenges more demanding, and the judges' expectations are greater than ever. (Америка)

bbc2.uk.title: A Course Called Ireland

On a misty day, the contender dash around the stalls in search of three items that they hope will sell for a profit at auction in Nottingham. Danny also visits a local college that saved a former passenger jet from the scrapheap and transformed it into a classroom for youngsters training to work in the air industry.

Will also calls in to Barr Castle in Galston, East Ayrshire, to repair a windowpane with a hand inscription by Robert Burns.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Ealing Broadway to South Kensington
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo reaches the capital. In the Queen of the Suburbs, Ealing, he finds comedy at the home of British cinema and is transformed for the silver screen by expert hair and make-up. In Fulham, Michael heads underground to London's new super sewer, which is taking shape beneath the River Thames. In central London, he visits the London School of Economics and Political Science. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Piccadilly Circus to Gravesend
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo hits the West End to explore an exotic store, which was a favourite among Edwardian ladies. At Covent Garden's Royal Ballet School he hears how in 1909 a Russian ballet company took London by storm and how its prima ballerina inspired the school's founding choreographer. Leaving the capital from Charing Cross, Michael heads for Dartford in Kent, where he discovers the origins of netball and gymslips at the North Kent College. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - East Malling to Rye
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo travels from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In the orchards of East Malling, Kent, Michael discovers that the Edwardians' serious attitude towards cultivation bore fruit. Rootstock developed at the NIAB Centre for Fruit Research, established in 1913, is today responsible for much of world apple production. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Newcastle to County Durham
eden.uk.plus1.description: Beginning just outside Newcastle in Jarrow, Michael uncovers the desperation which led 200 men to march 300 miles to Westminster in order to petition the Government for work. In Newcastle, Michael admires the city's iconic railway bridge before heading to Byker, where he discovers a new innovation in greyhound racing. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Kielder Forest to Edinburgh
eden.uk.plus1.description: Steered by his 1936 Bradshaw's Guide, Michael Portillo is in Northumbria en route to the Highlands. On this leg, he explores Kielder Forest, beginning at the County Show in Stocksfield. Michael discovers what lay behind a national initiative to plant one of the largest man-made woodlands in Europe. Crossing the border to Scotland, Michael arrives in the weaving town of Hawick to visit Lovat Mill, where, in the 1930s, tweed was big business. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Falkirk to Dundee
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo's railway journey through 1930s Britain from Newcastle to Loch Ness reaches Falkirk in Scotland. Here he discovers the Westerglen Transmitting Station, from where they continue to broadcast analogue radio signal to the Scottish borders. Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company Michael discovers the `Riviera of the Highlands'. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

stvnorth.uk.description: S20 E32 Swindon 4 David Dickinson and his team of dealers are at the Steam Museum in Swindon. Items include a huge Nelson-themed bottle which has been in a cupboard for 65 years, a charity shop bargain set of model toy battleships, and a family gold collection worth more than £10,000.

stvnorth.uk.title: Lingo
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E5 Scrabble enthusiasts Chele and husband Harry from Falkirk, Jeena and Reuben, new parents from Nuneaton, and football fanatical brothers Jordan and Greg from Watford use their powers of deduction to work out words that appear in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords. The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leaving with nothing. Hosted by Adil Ray.

stvnorth.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E13 Takea Stephen Mulhern hosts as Takea tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

stvnorth.uk.title: The Chase
stvnorth.uk.description: S18 E29 All that stands between Vincent, Anne, Lana and Gary and thousands of pounds is the small matter of one of the country's finest quiz brains, the Chaser. Bradley Walsh presents.

stvnorth.uk.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
stvnorth.uk.description: S6 E8 Interiors expert Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen has designs on the machine for its £20,000 charity jackpot, and artwork manager Deborah has a trade decision to make that draws her closer to a £10,000 prize.

stvnorth.uk.title: Emmerdale
stvnorth.uk.description: E10698 18/11/2026 Belle finds support in her family, Charles encourages Tom to find redemption and Caleb confesses his affair with Sadie to Cain.

stvnorth.uk.title: Coronation Street
stvnorth.uk.description: E11983 18/11/2026 Alya attempts to talk sense into Daniel, Susie's performance is curtailed by chickenpox, and Ryan asks Bethany to tell her family that he isn't the father of her unborn baby.

stvnorth.uk.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
stvnorth.uk.description: S26 E3 Ant and Dec reveal highlights from the last 24 hours as the contestants, including actor Joanna Page and TV presenter Ade Adepitan, adapt to life without their usual comforts. At least two major factors weigh on all of their minds - will they have enough to eat, and who will follow in the footsteps of Angry Ginge, winner of the 2025 series.

stvnorth.uk.title: Payback
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E1 Lexie Noble's idyllic family life in Edinburgh is plunged into jeopardy when her accountant husband, Jared, is attacked in a street near to their home. As she attempts to pick up the pieces and begins working with the police to establish what happened, Lexie is forced to face unthinkable truths as links to a notorious crime lord, Cal Morris, being to emerge. Crime drama, starring Morven Christie and Peter Mullan.

stvnorth.uk.description: E10699 19/11/2026 Ruby's business meeting takes a chaotic turn, Nicola discovers flowers from Tom on Jimmy's grave and Thea makes contact with Steve Marchant under false pretences.

stvnorth.uk.title: Coronation Street
stvnorth.uk.description: E11984 19/11/2026 Daniel refuses to believe Adam's claim that Idris duped him, Kit tackles Ryan on Sarah's instructions, Lily holds a vigil for Jodie, and Tyrone catches Sam upstairs with Hope.

stvnorth.uk.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!

stvnorth.uk.title: Scam Britain: Are You at Risk? - Tonight

With two thirds of people saying they live in fear of becoming a victim, what type of scams are being used, and how can viewers protect themselves? Paul Brand reports.

stvnorth.uk.title: Abbey Clancy: Celebrity Homes
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E4 Sheree Murphy and Caprice Actress and presenter Sheree Murphy shows Abbey how she's adapted her Cheshire mansion for her growing family, including a cinema room, boujee bar and her own dressing room. Model and entrepreneur Caprice reveals how she created a family home in London.

stvnorth.uk.title: Abbey Clancy: Celebrity Homes
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E2 Olivia Bowen and Emma Thynn Abbey hangs out with Love Islander and fashion blogger Olivia Bowen in the Essex mansion she always dreamt of living in as a child. She is also invited to Longleat House for a peek inside the private apartments of Emma Thynn, the Marchioness of Bath.

stvnorth.uk.title: Murder at the Grand Canal: True Crime Presents
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E5 Documentary exploring the death of 23-year-old Marta Ligman, whose body was found in a suitcase floating in the Grand Union Canal in Little Venice in north-west London.

stvnorth.uk.title: Scotland Revealed Moments
stvnorth.uk.description: Views of the country's stunning landscape and landmarks from the air, presented by Vanessa Collingridge.

stvnorth.uk.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
stvnorth.uk.description: Action sequel starring Tom Cruise and Cobie Smulders. After being wrongly accused of murder, Jack Reacher goes on the run with Major Turner, who has been accused of selling government secrets. Can they clear their names before being caught.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Directors - Terry Gilliam
talkingpictures.uk.description: Billy Wilder, From Greta Garbo's Ninotchka, film noir classic Double Indemnity to his academy award winning classics Lost Weekend, Sunset Boulevard and The Apartment. (Documentary, Entertainment) - 1999

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Devil's Fingers
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Liberace & Marilyn Hanold. Batman and Robin must stop a nefarious concert pianist who's plotting to kill Bruce and marry Aunt Harriet. (Action & Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Dead Ringers
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Liberace & Burt Ward. Batman and Robin escape Chandell's trap and plot to outsmart him and put a stop to his malicious plan. (Action & Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Third Party Risk
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1955. Crime. Directed by Daniel Birt. Stars Lloyd Bridges, Finlay Currie & Maureen Swanson. A man holidaying in Spain becomes inadvertently mixed up in a case of murder and microfilm smuggling. (Crime, Drama, Movie) - 1954

talkingpictures.uk.title: Impulse
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1955. Drama. Directed by Charles De la Tour & Cy Endfield. Stars Arthur Kennedy, Constance Smith & Joy Shelton. A night club singer tricks an estate agent into thinking he killed a jewel thief. (Movie) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hammer The Toff
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1952. Crime Drama by Maclean Rogers. The Toff tries to help Susan reunite with her uncle who's been targeted by criminals that are after his steel formula. (Crime, Movie) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: Great Day In The Morning
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1956. Western. A gambler wins a hotel in a card game but finds himself involved with women and the start of the civil war. Starring Robert Stack, Virginia Mayo & Ruth Roman. (Western, Movie) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: Four Star Playhouse - Let The Chips Fall
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1955. Stars Charles Boyer, Rhys Williams & Jean Willes. A reformed card sharp is enlisted to unmask a suspected poker cheat among a group of wealthy gamblers. (Comedy, Drama, Entertainment) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Buccaneers
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Decoy. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Virginia Maskell & Marne Maitland. Whilst Tempest sails to Charleston, he encounters a strange woman alone in a boat at sea who tells him a peculiar story. (Drama, Entertainment) - 2023

talkingpictures.uk.title: Doctor In Distress
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1963. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, James Robertson Justice & Samantha Eggar. Dr. Simon Sparrow's love life improves when the lovely Delia Mallory is brought into casualty. (Comedy, Movie) - 1963

talkingpictures.uk.title: Four Star Playhouse - The Lost Silk Hat
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1952. Stars Ronald Colman, Richard Whorf & Jay Novello. After a lovers' quarrel and a vow to never return, a man realises he has left behind his silk hat. How will he retrieve it. (Comedy, Drama, Entertainment) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
talkingpictures.uk.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November. (Entertainment) - 2001

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scandal Sheet
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1952. Crime. Directed by Phil Karlson. Stars John Derek, Donna Reed & Broderick Crawford. A newspaper editor accidentally kills his ex-wife and his protégé is assigned to investigate the story. (Crime, Thriller, Movie) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms - Miss. Peebles & Mr. Busby: Part 1
talkingpictures.uk.description: Miss Peebles and Mr Busby Pt1. Stars Graham Crowden, Anne Stallybrass and Sylvia Kay. Mr Busby, an eccentric elderly tenant, is accused of stealing from Miss Peebles. (Drama, Soap, Entertainment) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms - Miss. Peebles & Mr. Busby: Part 2
talkingpictures.uk.description: Miss Peebles and Mr Busby Pt2. Stars Graham Crowden, Anne Stallybrass and Sylvia Kay. Miss Peebles patience wears thin with Mr Busby upstairs. (Drama, Soap, Entertainment) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Out of Town
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Shooting Master. 1986. Lock, stock and barrel Jack explains the working of his great-grandfather's shotgun. Then he visits a shooting school on a disused railway line. (Documentary, Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Turpin - The Hero
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Kevin Brennan, David Daker. Dick takes pity on an unimpressive suitor, when the wealthy Phyllida is arranged to marry, helping to unite the young lovers. (Comedy, Drama, Entertainment) - 1979

talkingpictures.uk.title: Van der Valk
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Rainbow Ends Here. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. Van der Valk searches for a teenage girl abducted on her way to a clandestine rendezvous with a married man. (Crime, Drama, Entertainment) - 2020

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - 1979. Crime. Director Murder by Decree
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1979. Crime. Director: Bob Clark. Stars: Christopher Plummer, James Mason & David Hemmings. Holmes investigates Jack the Ripper's murders and discovers a conspiracy to protect the killer. (Crime, Drama, Mystery, Movie) - 1984

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Appointment - 1981. Horror. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lindsey C. Vickers. Stars Edward Woodward, Jane Merrow & Samantha Weysom. Ian misses his daughter's concert so he will have to contend with more than just childish sulking. (Drama, Movie) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers - 1946. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lewis Milestone. Stars Barbara Stanwyck, Van Heflin, Lizabeth Scott & Kirk Douglas. The relationships formed in childhood by three friends lead to murder and obsessive love. (Comedy, Mystery, Movie) - 2012

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life The Village Sleeps Again
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1962. A look at the arguments for and against building by-passes, featuring Transport Minister Ernest Marples. With a look at the by-passes being built and the effects on small towns and villages. (Documentary, Entertainment) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: Stagecoach West - The Renegades
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Renegades. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. (Crime, Western, Entertainment) - 1960

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Hizzonner the Penguin
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West & Burgess Meredith. Suspiciously endearing himself to the citizens of Gotham by foiling a robbery, the Penguin announces he is running for mayor. (Action & Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Dizzoner the Penguin
talkingpictures.uk.description: Dizzonner the Penguin. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Woodrow Parfrey. The Penguin kidnaps members of the election board in an attempt to sway the votes to become mayor in his favour. (Action & Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Directors - Tim Burton
talkingpictures.uk.description: Alfred Hitchcock defined his own unique style of filmmaking from the early days of the 39 Steps and the Lodger to the Hollywood glamour of North by Northwest. (Documentary, Entertainment) - 1999

talkingpictures.uk.title: Stock Car
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1955. Drama. After the death of her father while motor racing, the daughter is dissuaded from selling his garage by fellow racer Larry who helps her run it. (Drama, Movie) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Liz Fraser
talkingpictures.uk.description: Desert Mice. Talking Pictures was fortunate to film with Liz Fraser and discuss her life in film a few years ago. Here she talks exclusively to Robert Ross. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Desert Mice
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1959. Comedy. Set in WW2, this is the story of an ENSA troupe of entertainers. Starring Sid James, Dora Bryan, Alfred Marks and Liz Fraser. (Comedy, War, Movie) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: Love In Pawn
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1953. Comedy. Penniless couple Roger and Jean will get £10,000 if Roger can live a sober and profitable life. Starring Reg Dixon and John Laurie. (Comedy, Movie) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: So Long at the Fair - 1950. Mystery. Directors
talkingpictures.uk.description: Antony Darnborough & Terence Fisher. Stars Jean Simmons & Dirk Bogarde. Two siblings visit Paris for the Great Exhibition of 1889 when one of them goes missing. (Drama, Movie) - 2013

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Duchess of Duke Street - One Night's Grace
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Sally Osborne. Everyone is intrigued when an attractive young lady asks to see Lord Haslemere. Who is she and what is she after. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1976

talkingpictures.uk.title: The End of the Affair - 1955. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Edward Dmytryk. Stars Deborah Kerr, Van Johnson & John Mills. In WW2 London, a writer falls in love with the wife of a civil servant. Both men suspect her of infidelity. (Action & Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2017

talkingpictures.uk.title: Whispering Smith Hits London - 1952. Mystery. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Francis Searle. Stars Richard Carlson, Greta Gynt & Herbert Lom. US sleuth Whispering Smith arrives in London on holiday but soon becomes embroiled in a murder case. (Western, Movie) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: Weir's Way
talkingpictures.uk.description: An Edinburgh Volcano. 1981. Tom visits Arthur's Seat in Edinburgh, the most studied volcano in the world and where the very beginnings of geology were laid by Edinburgh geologist James Hutton. (Documentary, Entertainment) - 1979

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - The Guilt Behind the Gingerbread
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Guilt Beneath the Gingerbread. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Bill Treacher & Timothy Carlton. Brian finds himself alone to answer police questioning. Meanwhile, unrest at the depot continues. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1972

talkingpictures.uk.title: Mark Saber
talkingpictures.uk.description: Man About To Die. 1958. Stars Donald Gray & Neil McCallum. The hero of a children's sci-fi programme on television is a man without enemies, or so he thinks until someone threatens his life. (Crime, Drama, Entertainment) - 1954

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1975. Julie Rogers performs 'My World Gets Smaller Every Day', and Wild Honey perform 'I Can't Leave You Alone'. Plus, Dustin Gee, Ronnie Dukes and Ricki Lee star. (Comedy, Reality, Entertainment) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lord Jim
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1965. Adventure. Directed by Richard Brooks. Stars James Mason, Peter O'Toole & Curt Jurgens. A discredited seaman, desperately seeking to redeem himself, agrees to deliver a dangerous shipment. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: Up The Chastity Belt - 1971. Comedy. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Bob Kellett. Stars: Frankie Howerd, Eartha Kitt, Anna Quayle, Roy Hudd. Lurkalot is a serf who sells chastity belts and love potions at the local market place. (Comedy, Movie) - 2013

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Home of Your Own
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Jay Lewis Stars Ronnie Barker, Peter Butterworth & Bernard Cribbins. A wordless, satirical look at British builders as they attempt to build a young couple's dream home. (Comedy, Movie) - 1964

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sergeant Cork
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Case of the Knotted Scarf. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Brewster Mason. A woman is found dead, strangled with a knotted scarf. Leaving behind a husband some 26 years her senior. (Crime, Drama, Entertainment) - 1963

talkingpictures.uk.title: Burke's Law - Who Killed Rosie Sunset?
talkingpictures.uk.description: Who Killed Rosie Sunset? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A nice old lady has been murdered. Who and why would do such thing. She only sold maps of stars homes. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1963

When sadistic mobster Iosef Tarasov (Alfie Allen) and his thugs steal John's prized car and kill the puppy that was a last gift from his wife, John unleashes the remorseless killing machine within and seeks vengeance. Meanwhile, Iosef's father (Michael Nyqvist) -- John's former colleague -- puts a huge bounty on John's head. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: I Love You Forever
cinemax.us.description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Biggest Little Farm
cinemax.us.description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles. (Documentary) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Joshy
cinemax.us.description: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party. (Comedy drama) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

cinemax.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemax.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Animated, Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2021

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemax.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait. (Historical drama, LGBTQ, Drama) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Joshy
cinemax.us.description: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party. (Comedy drama) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Jazz) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemaxaction.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2018-06-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2018-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemaxaction.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2018-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxaction.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-06-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: Man Down
cinemaxaction.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-09-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1984-12-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Player
cinemaxaction.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Epic
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children) - 2013-05-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hitcher
cinemaxaction.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Action, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1986-05-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Darkest Minds
cinemaxaction.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2018-08-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2010-10-08

cinemaxaction.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 1989

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1972-03-12

cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura). (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1971-07-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1973-03-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxaction.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-08-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World

Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Action, Adventure, Children, Comedy, Family) - 1992

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-02-23

The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-24

When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun

Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun II

cinemaxwest.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl

However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

(Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

cinemaxwest.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)

Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

(Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemaxwest.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Whistlers

cinemaxwest.us.title: My Blind Brother

But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxwest.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemaxwest.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxwest.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2

Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemaxwest.us.title: Extraction

cinemaxwest.us.title: Full Metal Jacket

Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. cinemaxwest.us.title: The East

When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver, and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory (Ellen DeGeneres) -- who has a really short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2003

freeform.us.title: Finding Dory

Her journey brings her to the Marine Life Institute, a conservatory that houses diverse ocean species. Dory now knows that her family reunion will only happen if she can save mom and dad from captivity. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Family Feud Favorites
gameshowcentral.us.description: "Family Feud" has seen some crazy moments over the years, so buckle up as we revisit these fan favorites. This fast-paced clip show delivers the funniest, most viral and most unforgettable highlights from America's favorite game show. (Show, Series, Comedy, Game show) - 20250915

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It
gameshowcentral.us.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

gameshowcentral.us.title: America Says
gameshowcentral.us.description: Game show series have been making a comeback in television, and media and "America Says" is no exception. This program is following in the footsteps of the popular mobile app game "HQ Trivia." The network is planning its own spin on the game show, and Fran Shea, evp, programming and marketing, says she "has been studying the GSN audience and prepared a slate of new shows that reflect what it wants: family-friendly, fun, escapist television." golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Sara Brown & Brian Cooper
golfpass.us.description: Sara Brown graced Golf Channel screens with strong runs at Big Break Sandals and Big Break Dominican Republic; she is running a family, occasionally herding preschoolers and being the ultimate team mom for her husband’s other successful squad.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Isaac Sanchez & Chad Pfeifer
golfpass.us.description: We catch up with former Big Break competitors Isaac Sanchez and Chad Pfeifer. Sanchez, who goes by the nickname "Sasquatch," is in actuality a gentle giant. But that didn't stop the competitor in him from creating some mythical moments.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Mallory Blackwelder, Julien Trudeau & Robbie Biershenk
golfpass.us.description: They began as members of opposite teams on Big Break Ireland; Mallory Blackwelder and Julien Trudeau ended as the series' first married couple; in between, Mallory was a standout on Big Break NFL for Team Brown; meet the rest of their new team.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Don Donatello & Stefanie Kenoyer; Al Del Greco
golfpass.us.description: Don Donatello earned notoriety for his outbursts and antics, but quickly became heralded as a gritty competitor. Appearances on Big Break IV U.S. vs. Europe and Big Break Reunion solidified Donatello as legendary.

golfpass.us.title: The Swing Gym - Don Saladino - Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Exercises to help golf game.

golfpass.us.title: The Swing Gym - Don Saladino - Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Fitness coach Don Saladino helps maximize distance, improve flexibility and play pain-free golf.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Central - On-Site
golfpass.us.description: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf. The game's only live, daily news source provides more than just scores, delivering in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Playing in the Wind - Playing Downwind and Into the Wind
golfpass.us.description: Nick Dougherty breaks down the art of playing downwind and into the wind. Nick will guide you through techniques to maximize distance, control trajectory, and adjust your club selection to take full advantage of the wind.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Playing in the Wind - Right to Left Left to Right
golfpass.us.description: Nick Dougherty teaches techniques and tips for achieving excellent golf performance when playing into the wind. He shows how to maximize distance, control trajectory, and adjust club selection to make the most of the weather conditions.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Swing Checkpoints, Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Debbie Doniger is here to go through the checkpoints of the golf swing -- from the setup to the top of the backswing. She's got individualized tips and drills for each position to help golfers play their best golf and own their swing.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Swing Checkpoints, Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Debbie Doniger is back to go through the rest of the checkpoints of the swing -- from the transition through impact. Plus, with this newfound knowledge, she'll help put all the checkpoints together to have golfers swinging their best in no time.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Classic Algarve
golfpass.us.description: At Salgados in the Algarve, Chris plays the seventh hole, a par 4, and enjoys an afternoon in the sunshine as he takes on the palm-lined course.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Ocean and Estuary
golfpass.us.description: Chris and Paul play the 16th hole at the Royal course at Vale do Lobo, a famous course in Portugal.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Algarve to Lisbon
golfpass.us.description: Paul and Chris play the 18th hole at Quinta do Lago Laranjal in the Algarve, the newest of the three courses at Quinta do Lago.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Cascais and Coastlines
golfpass.us.description: Paul and Chris play the sixth hole, a dogleg par 4, at a hilltop course in Lisbon, Portugal, at Penha Longa in the Cascais area.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Dunes and Debuts
golfpass.us.description: Paul and Chris play the 14th hole in Aroeira near Lisbon, Portugal, a course that Paul knows well from playing the Portuguese Open.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - A Fitting Finale
golfpass.us.description: Chris plays the 18th hole, a par 4, on a misty day at a course in West Cliffs, an hour's drive north of Lisbon, Portugal.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Masters Edition Volume 1

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Xander & Stefan Schauffele
golfpass.us.description: Instructor Chris Como is on a journey to explore golf's leading teachers and influencers who are shaping the game for future generations. Como travels the world in search of the culture, philosophy, and technology of successful players and coaches.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - David Leadbetter
golfpass.us.description: David Leadbetter demonstrates the drills and techniques he taught Nick Faldo before he won six major championships. Leadbetter also reveals how to perfectly grip the club and the technology he trusts when teaching his students.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Bryson DeChambeau - Building His Swing
golfpass.us.description: Chris travels to Dallas National Golf Club and spends a day with multiple-time PGA Tour winner Bryson DeChambeau and his long-time coach, Mike Schy. Bryson explains the origin of his single-length clubs and the mechanics he learned at a young age.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Course Management with Scott Fawcett
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como travels to Texas and learns the course management strategies Scott Fawcett teaches through a combination of shot distribution patterns and PGA scoring stats. Learn where to aim off the tee and which type of shot to play out of trouble.

masn.us.title: In Depth With Graham Bensinger

masn.us.title: Charlie Moore: No Offense
masn.us.description: Fishing enthusiast Charlie Moore, also known as "The Mad Fisherman," is stepping out of his comfort zone and into the worlds of his guests, but first they have to visit his. In each episode, a special guest is invited into Charlie's world, and then the roles are reversed. When it's his turn, Charlie immerses himself in the local culture of the town he visits, wanting to experience everything that makes it special, from the best places to eat to favorite fishing destinations, and nobody is safe from his comedic critiquing. (Outdoors, Hunting, Fishing) - 2011-02-04

mgmplus.us.title: A Christmas Carol

mgmplus.us.title: Home for the Holidays
mgmplus.us.description: When her teenage daughter opts out of Thanksgiving, single mother Claudia Larson (Holly Hunter) travels alone to her childhood home for an explosive holiday dinner with her dysfunctional family. Claudia quickly tires of her parents, her long-suffering sister (Cynthia Stevenson), her snobby brother-in-law (Steve Guttenberg) and her nutty aunt (Geraldine Chaplin). But the evening gets interesting when sparks fly between Claudia and her brother's handsome friend Leo Fish (Dylan McDermott). (Holiday, Comedy) - 1995

mgmplus.us.title: The Preacher's Wife
mgmplus.us.description: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife". (Fantasy) - 1996

mgmplus.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 5: Skeleton Island
mgmplus.us.description: On Skeleton Island, Jim leads the search for the treasure as tension and paranoia rise when the island's dark history emerges; jockeying for control, they finally reach the fortune, but an unexpected force intervenes before anyone can claim it. (Adventure) - 2026-11-08

mgmplus.us.title: Treasure Island - Chapter 6: A Princesa De Aveiro
mgmplus.us.description: Captive on Skeleton Island, Jim turns the tables in an attempt to catch up to Long John before he can leave with the treasure; back at sea, alliances fracture and reunite, binding the survivors together in a dangerous new partnership. (Adventure) - 2026-11-15

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - The Reckoning
mgmplus.us.description: After their escape, Luke and friends plot to end the Institute for good; the Director enlists a new ally; Sigsby seeks a way back in. (Thriller) - 2026-11-08

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - The Sanctuary
mgmplus.us.description: The crew is on the run once again; the Institute struggles after a setback; desperate, Luke makes a choice that may cost him everything he holds dear. (Thriller) - 2026-11-15

mgmplus.us.title: Chaplin
mgmplus.us.description: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charles Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972. (Biography) - 1992

mgmplus.us.title: The Great Gatsby
mgmplus.us.description: Nick Carraway (Sam Waterston) is a young man from the Midwest living modestly among the decadent mansions of 1920s Long Island. He becomes involved in the life of the mysterious Jay Gatsby (Robert Redford), a rich man who throws the most lavish parties on the island. But behind Gatsby's outgoing demeanor is a lonely man who wants nothing more than to be with his old love, Daisy (Mia Farrow). She is married to the bullheaded Tom (Bruce Dern), creating a love triangle that will end in tragedy. (Drama) - 1974

mgmplus.us.title: Dressed to Kill
mgmplus.us.description: When Liz Blake (Nancy Allen), a prostitute, sees a mysterious woman brutally slay homemaker Kate Miller (Angie Dickinson), she finds herself trapped in a dangerous situation. mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In West Canaan, Texas, high school football reigns supreme. When starting quarterback Lance Harbor (Paul Walker) turns up injured, the Coyotes' ruthless coach, Bud Kilmer (Jon Voight), must promote benchwarmer Jonathon "Mox" Moxon (James Van Der Beek) to lead the team in its quest for a divisional title. Suddenly thrown into the spotlight, Mox must deal with the pressure of carrying the aspirations of an entire town on his shoulders, as he struggles to pursue his own very different dreams. (Comedy drama, Romance, Action) - 1999

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Biker Boyz
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Slick Will, the mechanic for a legendary motorcycle racer named Smoke (Laurence Fishburne), is struck dead during an off-the-grid race. Following the funeral, and in opposition to his mother's protests, Slick Will's son, Kid (Derek Luke), starts racing in the same fringe circuit -- but, despite Kid's skill and showmanship, Smoke refuses to race him. Spurned by the man he looked up to, Kid starts a rival motorcycle gang called the Biker Boyz, and a showdown between them is inevitable. (Action, Drama, Crime drama) - 2003

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: From Beyond
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Obsessive scientist Dr. Pretorius (Ted Sorel) successfully discovers a way to access a parallel universe of pleasure by tapping into the brain's pineal gland. When he is seemingly killed by forces from this other dimension, his assistant, Dr. Crawford Tillinghast (Jeffrey Combs), is accused of the murder. After psychiatrist Katherine McMichaels (Barbara Crampton) and detective Bubba Brownlee (Ken Foree) take the case, the trio risks a return to the other world in order to solve the mystery. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1986

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Barbershop
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A smart comedy about a day in the life of a barbershop on the south side of Chicago. Calvin (Ice Cube), who inherited the struggling business from his deceased father, views the shop as nothing but a burden and a waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy and struggles with the notion that he just sold it out. (Comedy) - 2002

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: This sequel to the 2002 film returns to the Chicago barbershop owned by Calvin Palmer Jr. (Ice Cube). His employees -- Isaac (Troy Garity), Terri (Eve), Ricky (Michael Ealy), Dinka (Leonard Earl Howze) and Kenard -- have their own personal and workplace problems, and a new barbershop called Nappy Cutz has moved in across the street. As Calvin tries to change the character of his business, Nappy Cutz and gentrification become a threat to the surrounding community. (Comedy) - 2004

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Beauty Shop
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Far from Chicago, hairdresser Gina Norris has relocated to Atlanta with her daughter and has quickly established herself as a rare talent in her profession. But after repeatedly butting heads with her shady, over-the-top boss, Jorge, Norris sets out to create her own salon -- even snagging a few of Jorge's employees and clients, including Lynn and Terri, respectively. Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down. (Comedy) - 2005

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: To survive harsh economic times, Calvin and Angie have merged the barbershop and beauty salon into one business. The days of male bonding are gone as Eddie and the crew must now contend with sassy female co-workers and spirited clientele. As the battle of the sexes rages on, a different kind of conflict has taken over Chicago. Crime and gangs are on the rise, leaving Calvin worried about the fate of his son. Together, the friends come up with a bold plan to take back their beloved neighborhood. (Comedy) - 2016

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Boomerang
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline. (Romantic comedy) - 1992

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Elizabethtown
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Aspiring young shoe designer Drew Baylor (Orlando Bloom) gets fired from his high-profile job after the failure of his latest project. To make matters worse, his girlfriend, Ellen (Jessica Biel), leaves him, and he becomes suicidal. Drew's morbid plans are interrupted by the news of his father's death, and he is called back to his Kentucky hometown. On his flight home, he meets the lovely Claire (Kirsten Dunst), a sunny flight attendant who tries to help him embrace life once again. (Comedy drama, Romance, Dark comedy) - 2005

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Everything, Everything
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Maddy (Amandla Stenberg) is a smart, curious and imaginative 18-year-old who is unable to leave the protection of the hermetically-sealed environment within her house because of an illness. Olly (Nick Robinson) is the boy next door who won't let that stop them from being together. Gazing through windows and talking only through texts, Maddy and Olly form a deep bond that leads them to risk everything to be together, even if it means losing everything. (Romance, Drama) - 2017

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Uptown Girls
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Molly Gunn (Brittany Murphy) has never worked a day in her life and has lived like a queen since her father, a famous rock 'n' roll star, died and left her his fortune. But everything changes when Molly realizes that her manager has stolen her money. She lands a job as a nanny for Ray (Dakota Fanning), a young girl whose serious attitude is the opposite of Molly's carefree one. With help from her boyfriend, Neal (Jesse Spencer), Molly tries to bond with Ray and learn how to be an adult. (Comedy) - 2003

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Regretting You
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal, Morgan Grant and her daughter, Clara, explore what's left behind as they confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other. (Drama, Romance) - 2025

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Roofman
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: After escaping from prison, former soldier and professional thief Jeffrey Manchester finds a hideout inside a Toys "R" Us, surviving undetected for months while planning his next move. However, when Jeffrey falls for a divorced mom, his double life starts to unravel, setting off a compelling and suspenseful game of cat and mouse as his past closes in. (Comedy drama) - 2025

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Ironweed
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In Depression-era Albany, N.Y., erstwhile baseball star Francis Phelan has become an alcoholic vagabond after guilt over accidentally killing his infant son led him to desert his family. Over the course of several days, he ambles from gritty job to dirty bar to makeshift sleeping quarters. By chance, he encounters fellow itinerant drinker and his sometime lover, Helen Archer. Together, they wax nostalgic about their haunted pasts. (Drama) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Tommy's Honour
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Tom and Tommy Morris, father and son pioneers of professional golf, relied on skill, business acumen and working-class street smarts to make Tommy one of the world's first sports superstars and found the modern game of golf. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2016

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Count of Monte-Cristo
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Edmond Dantes becomes the target of a sinister plot and is arrested on his wedding day for a crime he did not commit. After 14 years in the island prison of Château d'If, he manages a daring escape. Now rich beyond his dreams, he assumes the identity of the Count of Monte Cristo and exacts his revenge on the three men who betrayed him. (Adventure, Drama) - 2024

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Masters of the Universe
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon. (Fantasy) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Hercules
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Now a traveling mercenary, Hercules must once again become a hero to help the benevolent king of Thrace protect his people from a powerful warlord. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2014

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Underworld
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Under cover of night, vampires engage in an age-old battle with their sworn enemies, the Lycans, a clan of violent werewolves. Selene, a vampire orphaned in the wake of a bloody Lycan attack, works for the vampire clan as a trained killer. When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline. (Fantasy, Action, Horror, Thriller) - 2003

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Vampire Carnival
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A mysterious carnival lures a directionless young woman from her broken home, but a secret about its troupe forces her to face her demons. (Horror, Romance) - 2026
