turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Elmer Gantry
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When hedonistic but charming con man Elmer Gantry (Burt Lancaster) meets the beautiful Sister Sharon Falconer (Jean Simmons), a roadside revivalist, he feigns piousness to join her act as a passionate preacher. The two make a successful onstage pair, and their chemistry extends to romance. Both the show and their relationship are threatened, however, when one of Gantry's ex-lovers (Shirley Jones) decides that she has a score to settle with the charismatic performer. (Drama) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Train
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: With the Allies poised to retake Paris from the Germans, Col. Franz Von Waldheim (Paul Scofield) conspires to sneak out by train all the art masterpieces looted by the German army. But museum curator Mademoiselle Villard (Suzanne Flon) alerts the French Resistance, and soon railway inspector Paul Labiche (Burt Lancaster) is pressed into service. He reroutes the train, and cleverly deceives Von Waldheim by renaming each train station along the way. (Action, Thriller, War) - 1965

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Gypsy Moths
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Three men who work in a skydiving performance group -- burned-out Mike (Burt Lancaster), outgoing showman Joe (Gene Hackman) and rookie Malcolm (Scott Wilson) -- find work in a small Kansas town and lodging at the home of Malcolm's Uncle John (William Windom) and Aunt Elizabeth (Deborah Kerr). The couple are in the midst of a marital crisis, and when Elizabeth meets the dashing Mike, everyone is surprised by their passionate and dangerous love affair. (Drama) - 1969

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Princess O'Rourke
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters. (Romantic comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Marie Antoinette
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The young Austrian princess Marie Antoinette (Norma Shearer) is arranged to marry Louis XVI (Robert Morley), future king of France, in a politically advantageous marriage for the rival countries. The opulent Marie indulges in various whims and flirtations, including Count Axel (Tyrone Power). When Louis XV (John Barrymore) passes and Louis XVI ascends the French throne, his queen's extravagant lifestyle earns the hatred of the French people, who despise her Austrian heritage. (Biography) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Swan
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Prince Albert, who is scouring Europe for a wife, arrives in a tiny town to visit a banished family of nobles. Their matriarch, Beatrix, wants her daughter, Alexandra, to marry Albert so that her family will be welcomed back into the kingdom. In order to rouse Albert's attention, Alexandra flirts with her attractive tutor, Dr. Agi; however, Alexandra's plan hits a snag when she develops genuine feelings for Dr. Agi. (Romantic comedy) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Her Highness and the Bellboy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A New York hotel bellboy (Robert Walker) forgets his girlfriend (June Allyson) after meeting a European princess (Hedy Lamarr). (Romantic comedy) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Glass Slipper
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In a retelling of the "Cinderella" tale, young orphan Ella (Leslie Caron) lives with her unpleasant stepmother (Elsa Lanchester) and stepsisters (Amanda Blake, Lisa Daniels), essentially working as their housekeeper. When the local prince (Michael Wilding) returns from school, a ball is announced. Around that time, Ella meets the prince, who is disguised as the son of the palace chef, and the two fall in love. When she manages to attend the ball, his revealed identity causes quite a stir. (Children, Musical, Romance) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Pirate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Manuela Alva is unhappily engaged to Don Pedro, the mayor of her town. When a circus arrives, she's enchanted by performer Serafin, who's likewise smitten with her. The mayor tries to evict the circus from town, but Serafin turns the tables after realizing Don Pedro is Macoco, an ex-pirate in hiding. When Serafin learns that Manuela dreams of Macoco, he adopts the discarded identity to woo her — but is then condemned to death for the pirate's crimes. (Musical) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This adventure-filled drama finds Englishman Rudolf Rassendyll (Ronald Colman) on vacation in a small European country, where he discovers his resemblance to the nation's royal heir-apparent, Rudolf V. When the king-to-be is drugged and incapacitated, Rassendyll must impersonate him, so that the scheming Duke Michael (Raymond Massey) can't assume the throne. To further complicate matters, Rassendyll starts to fall for Rudolf V's intended bride, Flavia (Madeleine Carroll). (Adventure) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Edge of Eternity
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Widowed Les Martin is an ex-detective haunted by a case he left behind in Denver. Now, Martin is the deputy sheriff of a small Arizona town with nothing to do but pull over beautiful local socialite Janice Kendon for occasional speeding -- until a mysterious murder at a nearby ghost town requires him to put his old skills to use once again. With the help of Sheriff Edwards and Kendon, Martin must unravel a murderous plot involving stolen gold. (Western) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Easy Rider
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wyatt (Peter Fonda) and Billy (Dennis Hopper), two Harley-riding hippies, complete a drug deal in Southern California and decide to travel cross-country in search of spiritual truth. On their journey, they experience bigotry and hatred from the inhabitants of small-town America and also meet with other travelers seeking alternative lifestyles. After a terrifying drug experience in New Orleans, the two travelers wonder if they will ever find a way to live peacefully in America. (Drama) - 1969

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Grapes of Wrath
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The Joad clan, introduced to the world in John Steinbeck's iconic novel, is looking for a better life in California. After their drought-ridden farm is seized by the bank, the family -- led by just-paroled son Tom -- loads up a truck and heads West. On the road, beset by hardships, the Joads meet dozens of other families making the same trek and holding onto the same dream. Once in California, however, the Joads soon realize that the promised land isn't quite what they hoped. (Drama) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Roadhouse 66
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The villainous Hoot (Alan Autry), who patrols the desolate highways of the American Southwest with a gang of high-octane thugs, picks the wrong target: uptight and seemingly harmless Beckman Hallsgood Jr. (Judge Reinhold), who's on his way to California from New York on business. After Hoot and his men nearly force Beckman into an accident, Beckman gets some tips on payback from Johnny Harte (Willem Dafoe), a hitchhiking former musician who wants to take Hoot down and make the roads safe again. (Action, Comedy) - 1984

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Paris, Texas
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A disheveled man who wanders out of the desert, Travis Henderson (Harry Dean Stanton) seems to have no idea who he is. When a stranger manages to contact his brother, Walt (Dean Stockwell), Travis is awkwardly reunited with his sibling. Travis has been missing for years, and his presence unsettles Walt and his family, which also includes Travis's own son, Hunter (Hunter Carson). Soon Travis must confront his wife, Jane (Nastassja Kinski), and try to put his life back together. (Drama) - 1984

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Daring Daughters
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Convinced that their mother, Louise Morgan (Jeanette MacDonald), is lonely and unhappy, Tess (Jane Powell), Alix (Mary Eleanor Donahue) and Ilka (Ann E. Todd) plot to reunite her with their irresponsible father, Charlie, with the help of his rich employer, Robert Nelson (Edward Arnold). On a cruise, however, Louise meets bandleader Jose (Jose Iturbi), and the couple secretly marry. Back home, Louise wonders how to reveal her marriage when the girls tell her that Charlie is returning. (Musical comedy) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Anchors Aweigh
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Joe (Gene Kelly) and Clarence (Frank Sinatra) are two young Navy sailors on leave in glitzy Los Angeles. The two men at first plan to use their layover as an opportunity to relax, but they soon find themselves in a complicated web of comic secrets. When the two buddies find a runaway boy and return him to his fame-hungry Aunt Susan (Kathryn Grayson), both men find themselves falling for the wannabe singer, setting off a series of misadventures that unfold in comedy and song. (Musical) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Despite being key players for the Wolves, baseball players Dennis Ryan (Frank Sinatra) and Eddie O'Brien (Gene Kelly) harbor a passion for vaudeville. When a local gambler (Edward Arnold) puts a lot of money on the Wolves to lose a big game, he tries to win the bet by offering Eddie the lead role in a newly produced show. Though Eddie is tempted to accept, he risks incurring the wrath of both Dennis and the team's owner (Esther Williams), who just happens to be his girlfriend. (Musical comedy) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thrill of a Romance
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Cynthia Glenn (Esther Williams), a beautiful swimming teacher, marries Robert (Carleton G. Young), a dull but wealthy white-collar worker. The couple travels to the scenic Sierra Nevada Mountains for their honeymoon, but Robert's work gets in the way of romance, and he leaves on a business trip. Before long, Thomas (Van Johnson), a distinguished serviceman on vacation, catches Cynthia's eye -- and the more she gets to know the soldier, the more she wishes she hadn't married Robert. (Musical) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: No Leave, No Love
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rushing to the hospital as his wife, Susan (Pat Kirkwood), is about to give birth, Michael Hanlon (Van Johnson) relates to another waiting father how he and Susan met. When Michael returns to New York from the war, he is ordered to appear on a popular armed services radio program hosted by Susan. Unwilling to appear, Michael talks his best friend, Slinky (Keenan Wynn), into impersonating him -- but he soon discovers Susan knows a secret about his personal life and must end the deception. (Musical comedy) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: For Me and My Gal
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jo Hayden (Judy Garland) and Harry Palmer (Gene Kelly) are a struggling vaudeville act with hopes of making it big. When success seems right around the corner, Palmer is drafted into the army at the advent of World War I. Thinking quickly, Palmer injures his hand to avoid being called to duty, but Hayden -- whose brother died in the war -- finds his action cowardly and breaks up the duo. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Epic
actionmax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: The Flash

With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: The Hitcher

After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: MacGruber
moremax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

moremax.us.title: The Player
moremax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
moremax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Hoot
moremax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

moremax.us.title: Isle of Dogs
moremax.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Animated, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Switch
moremax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Brian Banks
moremax.us.description: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL. (Biography, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
moremax.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Hitchcock
moremax.us.description: Following his great success with "North by Northwest," director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel "Psycho." When the studio refuses to back the picture, Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. His wife, Alma Reville, has serious reservations about the film but supports him nonetheless. Still, the production strains the couple's marriage. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Leave No Trace
moremax.us.description: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Ore., rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own. (Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: A History of Violence
moremax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Us
moremax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: Enemy
moremax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Inconceivable
moremax.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: My Dead Dad
moremax.us.description: Young burnout Lucas is notified that his estranged father has passed away and has left him an apartment complex in Los Angeles. Lucas meets the eclectic tenants, and soon discovers his father was a different man than the one he knew. (Drama) - 2021

moremax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Flash
moremax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Opus
moremax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Due Date
moremax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Internship
moremax.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges. (Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
moremax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Joker
moremax.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama) - 2019

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - In The Hills
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: When Simon returned to Adelaide, after studying to be a chef, he had a whole new appreciation for the Adelaide Hills. As a youngster he's tear around the hills on his motorbike. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura teams up with vegetable guru Catherine Velisha to create wonderful Prawn Dumplings, with spring onions as the hero ingredient. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Chicken Parm Patty Melts
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael puts a bold Italian spin on a classic patty melt with her chicken parmesan version, loaded with Italian seasoning, topped with mozzarella and provolone. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The season concludes on a luxurious note with one of the most beloved ingredients: butter. With its creamy, nutty sweetness, butter elevates every dish. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays - Holiday Lasagne
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael shows how to make delicious lasagna by layering sheets of pasta with cime di rapa, ricotta, and a ragu sauce that includes sweet sausage. It's then covered with cheese and baked to perfection. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura brings her young nephew Noah on the show and together they make cookies. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Barbecue
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie has a genius barbeque day as he cooks up everything from shellfish to lamb, chicken, ribs and even onions on the barbeque. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Think yoghurt is too hard to make yourself from scratch? Think again, Justine's mum shows you just how easy it is on today's episode of Everyday Gourmet. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Dinner SOS
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Adam and his guests, powerhouse hospitality duo Martin Benn and Vicki Wild, answer the dinner SOS distress call. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Diana Chan's Malaysia - Origins
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Origins visits Limapulo Terrace, experiences SSL Belacan Farm and cooks Nonya Kari Ayam and Sambal Hae Bee. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express - Retro Rapido
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nigella's going back in time to give her favourite retro recipes the express treatment. For her school and university friend it's cheese fondue followed by cherry cheesecake. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy - Venice
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Stanley Tucci visits the Veneto. Once the centre of a world-trading empire, Tucci explores the ingenuity of the Venetians, who have embraced the unexpected delights and challenges of the lagoon. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams - Lemon Chilli Chicken With Turmeric Rice
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour - Thailand: One Night In Bangkok
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: A spontaneous layover in Bangkok, Thailand leads Tony into the city, where he tries dishes of deep-fried frog skins, and pla rah, a fishpaste that has fermented anywhere from three months to a year. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of The Tropics - Taste Of The Tropics: Family & Friends

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Adam and his guests, powerhouse hospitality duo Martin Benn and Vicki Wild, answer the dinner SOS distress call. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Casserole With It

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E1 Series 5 Episode 1 Rob Brydon hosts with team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack who lead celebrity guests Jack Whitehall, Rebecca Front, Nick Hewer and Miranda Hart.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E2 Episode 2 Adam and Jamie test the action movie cliché of Dumpster Diving. When the hero's cornered on a rooftop, can a leap into a skip below really save you, or is it just Hollywood hype?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 New Malden It's a secret mission to challenge the very best of them as Phil heads to New Malden in Surrey, and a semi-detached family home which has the busy A3 in the front garden.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E7 Floating Home And A Magical Vista A couple creates an ambitious floating home; two siblings build their own mobile homes away from home; George and Will conjure up a magical 30-mile vista in a wall just 20 cm thick.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E13 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 3 Ace and Bellboy team up to stop the Chief Clown while the Doctor realises that he is next into the ring. The Captain has another trick up his sleeve and shows Mags's true colours.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E14 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 4 The Gods of Ragnarok are revealed and while waiting for Ace to escape the Chief Clown, the Doctor must entertain them as long as possible in the dimension of the Dark Circus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E4 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 4 The streets of East London shake under a civil war being fought between the Daleks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E7 The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E3 Battlefield: Part 3 Furious at her inability to find and engage Arthur in battle, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer upon the planet unless the Doctor gives her what she wants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E4 Battlefield: Part 4 The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's nuclear warhead and prepares to start a countdown that will destroy Earth forever.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E6 Ghost Light: Part 2 The Doctor and Scotland Yard’s finest, Inspector Mackenzie, attempt to question Josiah Smith while both Light and Control emerge from their respective slumbers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E7 Ghost Light: Part 3 Only Redvers, still searching for the elusve Saxe-Coburg, seems to be able to withstand Light and communicate with Control and Ace realises her past actions need to be dealt with.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E8 The Curse of Fenric: Part 1 As Russian forces approach the English coastline, an ancient evil stirs beneath the surface of the water. For Ace and the Doctor, a deadly game of revenge has begun.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E9 The Curse of Fenric: Part 2 The Viking runes in the crypt contain a secret to Ace’s past, while Millington and Judson’s Ultima machine offers to break the chains of the Wolves of Fenric.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E10 The Curse of Fenric: Part 3 The Haemovores attack St Jude’s church and the insane Millington willingly sacrifices his men. Doctor Judson dies, only to be reborn as the true evil, Fenric himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E11 The Curse of Fenric: Part 4 The Ancient Haemovore stands upon the Earth once again, determined to change the future by erasing the past and Ace finally feels love for her mother.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E12 Survival: Part 1 Trying to work out why people have been disappearing from Perivale, Ace is cornered by a Cheetah-Person on a horse called Kara, who transports her to a far-off planet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E13 Survival: Part 2 The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People’s world, where the Master lies in wait. He cannot leave without the Doctor's assistance.

BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E5 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 1 UNIT are summoned to Wenley Moor research station which is experiencing mysterious power losses. In the nearby caves, one of the staff has been killed and another sent insane.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E6 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 2 Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature. Dr Quinn is hiding a secret that could endanger the lives of everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E7 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 3 The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor. Dr Quinn attempts to recover it and is unwilling to listen to the Doctor’s warnings.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E8 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 4 Fearful of a war breaking out between the Silurians and mankind, the Doctor attempts to make peace between the races. But there are those on both sides unwilling to listen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E9 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 5 When the Silurian leader is killed, all hopes of peace are lost. The Silurian’s infect Major Baker with a virus deadly to humans and release him to spread the infection.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E10 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 6 As the Silurian plague quickly spreads, the Doctor desperately searches for a cure. But the Silurians are aware of the Doctor’s efforts and intend to stop him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E11 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 7 With the antidote to the plague found, the Silurians retaliate and take over the research centre. They now intend to destroy the Van Allen Belt, resulting in death for all mankind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E12 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 1 Contact has been lost with Mars Probe 7. When contact is also lost with the recovery ship, UNIT is called in and the Doctor learns that someone is sending messages to the vessel.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E13 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 2 Recovery 7 has returned to Earth but the UNIT convoy transporting the capsule is ambushed. The Doctor is able to relocate the capsule, but is he too late?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E14 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 3 The recovery capsule is empty with the astronauts seemingly kidnapped. But Liz notices that the radiation count is high and the Doctor deduces that the occupants were not human.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E15 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 4 Liz has been captured by Reegan who is holding the three aliens captive. The Doctor suspects Quinlan’s part in the conspiracy, but Quinlan is killed before he can reveal the truth.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S13 E3 Car Wash Chaos When the kids set up a car wash competition, Sarah finds herself trapped in a car up to its windows in water. Time to call Ocean Rescue!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 Nikhil and Jay and the Fairy Godbrothers Nikhil and Jay become Fairy Godbrothers to help Nana and Amma go to see their favourite band together! Can they overcome all the obstacles in their way?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E90 More to Explore It's time for the grand finale but the number fun doesn't stop here.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Science Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E3 Making Snow Can you make snow that isn't freezing cold? There's snow place like home to create your own winter wonderland! Find out how to make your own snow with Alex using bi-carb soda and hair conditioner.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pop Paper City
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Howdy There Hooper On today's poptastic adventure, Hooper becomes Pop Paper City's cowboy sheriff. But when Sheriff Hooper makes a mistake, can he own up to his friends?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E33 Happy Birthday Winkles Winkles' friends have a surprise party planned for him. But when he looks like he might discover it before they are ready, they distract Winkles by asking him to fix things all over town.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S367 E3 Ball Sports Abi and Kaeng have a blast playing ball sports! They are joined by Australian soccer players, Jada Whyman and Abbey Lemon, for an intense game of soccer with the toys. Abi and Kaeng play a long game of cricket.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Wiggle And Learn
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E23 Episode 23 Join Lachy, Evie and the rest of The Wiggles as they sing, dance, and act out a beloved fairy tale as Jazzy Wolf and Little Red Riding Hood!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E25 Diggers Fizzy and Suds explore diggers! They watch a giant bucket scoop rocks, learn how tracks help move on rough ground, and see these powerful machines saw, sift, and crush at construction sites.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: L'il Stompers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 L'il Baby Tree The l'il dinos discover a baby tree growing near the pond and set out to learn how to care for it. At first, they're not sure how, but then they get an idea: find a grown-up tree of the same kind.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Fly Bok, Fly Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes must teach a lost baby BokChoydactyl how to fly so it can return to it's parents. Unfortunately baby Bokchoydactyls are terrible flyers.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E33 Tree Of Life The junior gardeners visit a living tree museum at the Arboretum in Canberra and take a trip around the world - in trees!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Wild Workouts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Rainforest Andy is off on a rainforest adventure and he wants you to come along! He treks into deep rainforest in search of an orangutan. Along the way he swings through the trees with some spider monkeys and dances with manakin birds.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E21 The Magic Spyglass Santi and crew are after the legendary Magic Spyglass! But things get tricky when Enrique Real de Palacios III joins the chase.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Blueberry Bonanza Zsa-Zsa steals all the blueberries at the blueberry festival for her special cream.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 The Opposites Badge Duggee has his Opposites Badge, and helps the squirrels understand that an opposite is something that is exactly different to another thing, by using lots of fun examples.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Bike At the park, Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends' determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E34 Magnets Grandpa Pig shows off his magnet collection but when his new magnet arrives, it's a bit too big!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E65 Sailing Home It is the end of the holiday and Peppa is sad. George rides on his potato whilst Peppa tries out another (differently themed) splash pool.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: MaeBee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Mae, Bee and the Forgotten Place Mae and Bee encourage their friend, Tiger, a blind witch's cat, to trust his senses and find his lost place in the treetops, bringing the spark back to his magic whiskers.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Best Friends Forever Big Lizard is jealous of the vacuum cleaner and hides it from Dad and Cosima. Ammon decides it's her new best friend, whilst Cosima reassures Big Lizard he will always be her BFF.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 The Octonauts And The Slime Eels Kwazii covets the treasure in a sunken pirate ship - but it's protected by slime-squirting Slime Eels.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Frizzy's Big Show! When a TV crew shows up to film real life rescues on Kangaroo Beach, Frizzy vows to become world famous by being rescued.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E6 A Mermaid in Pitchfork Pines Drac and his Monster Pets help a mermaid embrace her uniqueness by learning to glide above water.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Mystery on Goblin Island When the team is trapped on an Island with a prank-throwing lighthouse, the team must save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Bob Bilby When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to put down their screens and show him a good time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Flour's Big Day Out While Flower, Penny, and Dirk head out for the day, Flour the cat sneaks off on his own mischievous adventure around the plaza.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E38 The Witch Competition A young witch is planning on moving into Mrs Witch's house. Mrs Witch has to come out of retirement to keep her place in the Little Kingdom.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Looph 2.0 Looph builds a robot to give a science talk but the Piris encourage her to do it herself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E22 Fruit And Veggie Friends Day All the fruit and veggies in the supermarket are enjoying a day to celebrate friendship but Evil Pea is determined to ruin it.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Batwheels
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E19 Redbird-o-flage Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight. But when he needs to use the bat-o-flage and become invisible, he'll have to learn that doing good is its own reward.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E12 Sticky Gecko Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E16 The Pelican An unusual guest lands on the Farm. When Shaun and Bitzer realise it's hungry, they set about trying to find it some food - if only they could get their hands on the Farmer's prize catch!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ninjago
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E7 Wishmasters The last remaining Ninja dare to infiltrate the Sky Pirates in an attempt to save Jay and defeat Nadakhan once and for all.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E1 Half A Wiener Schnitzel and Underwear In A Tree News of the tornado reaches Sheldon and Mary in Germany. Also, with the Cooper house in chaos, Missy steps up.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E206 Episode 206 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E2 A Roulette Wheel and a Piano Playing Dog Sheldon realises he is the weakest student in his class; Meemaw is looking to expand her gambling business.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Animal Park
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S17 E4 Episode 4 A yule log for the lions and how do you take a pancake tortoise festive family photo?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Recipe of the Year
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 With the competition now entering the home stretch, our eight remaining home cooks return to the barn for a challenge that's all about creativity on a budget.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Merlin
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E9 The Lady Of The Lake Merlin meets a kindred spirit but his new friendship is threatened when a deadly magical beast attacks Camelot.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E13 The Car Wash With Jessica's writing career taking off, Louis worries that she is losing interest in him and attempts to rekindle the flame. At school, Evan is placed into Emery's literature class, and both compete to be the teacher's pet.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E20 German for Beginners and a Crazy Old Man with a Bat The gambling room gets broken into and Sheldon wants to study abroad. Also, Missy makes a new friend.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E34 Hokey Pokeballs In an attempt to help May train her new Bulbasaur, Ash asks Professor Oak to send his own Bulbasaur to him, but someone diverts the transport.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E45 Vegeta Disappears?! Menace Of The Duplicate Vegeta! After being drained of his energy, Vegeta and the others escape and learn more about the Superhuman Water. And if they don't stop the clones, Vegeta could disappear - for good.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E8 Queen Banana When Chloe gets akumatized into Queen Banana, Ladybug decides to entrust a Miraculous to a new and promising ally to help her stop the supervillain.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears

nbcuniverso.us.description: Las cuñadas Julia y Adriana participan para ganar muchos premios y multiplicarlos por dos. Los hermanos Eduardo y Mauricio quieren ganar un set para eventos sociales y dinero en efectivo. (Game Shows, Performing Arts)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Escape perfecto - Cambio de desafío
nbcuniverso.us.description: Antonio y Diana quieren llevarse el carro, pero después de usar los dos comodines, todo se enreda. Doña Rosa y Saúl cambian el reto del automóvil y prefieren multiplicar sus premios por dos. (Game Shows, Performing Arts)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - DJ Hugo; 25% de vida
nbcuniverso.us.description: Liz contrató los servicios de un imitador y un DJ para el lanzamiento de una bebida, pero se emborracharon. Perla va a perder su casa y su hermana no puede ayudarla por estar entre pandillas. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Microchip para mi madre; O te casas o te mueres
nbcuniverso.us.description: Manuela quiere someter a su madre a una cirugía experimental e implantar un chip en su cerebro. Eliana le pide matrimonio a la hija de Liliana a través de un video, pero con una soga al cuello. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - A corazón abierto; A los 70 también se termina
nbcuniverso.us.description: Daniela necesita un trasplante de corazón y su hija, con muerte cerebral, puede ser la donante; pero ella está embarazada y su pareja se opone. Anciana exige el divorcio por falta de atención. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Amarte es mi fortaleza
nbcuniverso.us.description: Cuando Rafael fue testigo de un asesinato, tuvo que huir y dejar atrás a su esposa Berenice sin dar ninguna explicación. Pero poco después, ella descubre que está embarazada y su amor por Rafael es su mayor fortaleza. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Amor y perdón
nbcuniverso.us.description: Natalia pierde a su bebé por la mala praxis médica de Daniel. El destino los une tiempo después, pero para que el amor surja entre ellos él debe ser perdonado por el error que cometió. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Dalia, una verdadera campeona
nbcuniverso.us.description: Un beso no deseado es el inicio de una revolución. Ante los abusos de su director técnico, el equipo se organiza y la estrategia de Dalia demuestra que las Chitas no solo saben marcar goles. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Regina: La víctima imperfecta
nbcuniverso.us.description: Después de años de vida en pareja y de dejar su trabajo como escritora para apoyarlo, Regina descubre que Santos es capaz de todo para tapar sus abusos y su forma de desvirtuar la realidad. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Magdalena: Con derecho a cumplir mis sueños
nbcuniverso.us.description: Magdalena vive para apoyar económicamente a sus hijos adultos. Sofía, su vecina, perdió la confianza tras su divorcio. Ambas se proponen apoyarse para superar los conflictos que las agobian. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Un día para vivir - Medium
nbcuniverso.us.description: Aldo hace creer a las personas que es médium y puede comunicarse con sus seres queridos fallecidos, pero la muerte lo confronta y lo obliga a asumir la responsabilidad por los daños causados. (Soaps, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Acércate a Rocío
nbcuniverso.us.description: Hablar de los problemas es el primer paso para superarlos y, por eso, Rocío trae un programa único para hablar de las preocupaciones de cada día y, en conjunto, encontrar una solución. (Talk Shows, Lifestyle)

But when a freshman is brutally murdered in his dorm, the student body is plunged into terror. When it happens again, investigators race to uncover a connection and stop a serial killer.

Bensinger chats with some of sports' biggest names, including pro football players Terrell Owens and Tony Romo, professional basketball player Kobe Bryant, boxing champion George Foreman and broadcaster Joe Buck. The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

wrsp.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
wrsp.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. fxm.us.title: The Invitation
fxm.us.description: After the death of her mother and having no other known relatives, Evie takes a DNA test and discovers a long-lost cousin she never knew she had. Invited by her newfound family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, Evie's at first seduced by the sexy aristocratic host. However, she's soon thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets about her family history and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity. (Horror, Thriller) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Missing
fxm.us.description: When her mother disappears while on vacation in Colombia with her new boyfriend, June's search for answers is hindered by international red tape. Stuck thousands of miles away in Los Angeles, June creatively uses all the latest technology at her fingertips to try and find her before it's too late. However, as she digs ever deeper, her digital sleuthing soon raises more questions than answers. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2023

fxm.us.description: After the death of her mother and having no other known relatives, Evie takes a DNA test and discovers a long-lost cousin she never knew she had. (Horror, Thriller) - 2022

fxm.us.title: How to Steal a Million
fxm.us.description: Charles Bonnet (Hugh Griffith) expresses his passion for art by forging masterpieces -- and selling them at a hefty profit. The trouble starts when his reproduction of a prized sculpture winds up in a famous Paris museum. If experts determine that it is inauthentic, Bonnet's reputation will be tarnished. That's why his fetching daughter, Nicole (Audrey Hepburn), hires cat burglar Simon Dermott (Peter O'Toole) to steal the sculpture back before it's too late. (Comedy) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Book of Life
fxm.us.description: In the Mexican town of San Angel, Manolo (Diego Luna), Maria (Zoë Saldana) and Joaquin (Channing Tatum) have been friends ever since childhood. Although their lives have taken different paths -- Maria was sent to Europe, Joaquin joined the military, and Manolo studied to become a bullfighter -- one thing remains the same: Manolo and Joaquin both want to marry Maria. Little does the trio know that battling husband-and-wife deities have made a high-stakes wager on the love triangle's outcome. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2014

fxm.us.title: Can-Can
fxm.us.description: Parisian nightclub owner Simone Pistache (Shirley MacLaine) is known for her performances of the can-can, a provocative dance recently outlawed for being immoral. Though her dancing delights patrons to no end, it also attracts the ire of the self-righteous Judge Philipe Forrestier (Louis Jourdan), who aims to punish her. The judge hatches a plot to photograph Simone in the act and ends up falling for her much to the chagrin of her boyfriend, handsome lawyer François Durnais (Frank Sinatra). (Musical) - 1960

fxm.us.title: Caprice
fxm.us.description: An industrial spy (Doris Day) for a cosmetics firm falls for another (Richard Harris) who may not be on her side. (Comedy) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Fathom
fxm.us.description: While touring abroad in Europe, beautiful American skydiver Fathom Harvill (Raquel Welch) gets wrapped up in international intrigue when Scottish spy Douglas Campbell (Ronald Fraser) recruits her to help him on a secret mission. Before long, Fathom realizes that no one around her, including the mysterious Peter Merriwether (Tony Franciosa), can easily be trusted, leading to various adventures that involve bullfighting, beaches and, of course, romance. (Action) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Fantastic Voyage
fxm.us.description: The brilliant scientist Jan Benes develops a way to shrink humans, and other objects, for brief periods of time. Benes, who is working in communist Russia, is transported by the CIA to America, but is attacked en route. In order to save the scientist, who has developed a blood clot in his brain, a team of Americans in a nuclear submarine is shrunk and injected into Benes' body. They have a finite period of time to fix the clot and get out before the miniaturization wears off. (Science fiction) - 1966

fxm.us.title: Ad Astra
fxm.us.description: Thirty years ago, Clifford McBride led a voyage into deep space, but the ship and crew were never heard from again. Now his son -- a fearless astronaut -- must embark on a daring mission to Neptune to uncover the truth about his missing father and a mysterious power surge that threatens the stability of the universe. (Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller) - 2019

fxm.us.title: The Last Full Measure
fxm.us.description: Airman William H. Pitsenbarger Jr. is awarded the Medal of Honor for his service and actions on the battlefield. (War, Drama) - 2019

fxm.us.title: The Aftermath
fxm.us.description: In 1946 Rachael Morgan arrives in the ruins of Hamburg to be reunited with her husband, Lewis, who is a British colonel charged with rebuilding the shattered city. As they set off for their new home, Rachael is stunned to discover that Lewis has made an unexpected decision: They will be sharing the grand house with its previous owners, a German widower and his troubled daughter. In this charged atmosphere, enmity and grief give way to passion and betrayal. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2019

fxm.us.title: FXM Presents
fxm.us.description: An examination of the process of making movies follows a production from script to screen. (Entertainment) - 2012-01-01

fxm.us.title: 100 Rifles
fxm.us.description: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Squad Car
fxm.us.description: An accused man (Don Marlowe) helps a policeman (Paul Bryar) investigate an airplane mechanic's death and a counterfeit racket. (Crime drama) - 1960

fxm.us.title: Berlin Correspondent
fxm.us.description: In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive. The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government. (Thriller) - 1942

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: Black Widow
fxm.us.description: At a party, Broadway producer Peter Denver (Van Heflin) meets Nancy Ordway (Peggy Ann Garner), a young writer struggling to make it in New York City. Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself. (Mystery) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Neptune Factor
fxm.us.description: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival. (Science fiction) - 1973

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: The Aftermath

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
5starmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Working Girls
5starmax.us.description: College graduate Molly (Louise Smith), trying to bankroll her own business, works as a high-priced New York City escort. As a lesbian, she's able to keep her emotional distance from the clients, who range from cynically exploitative to desperately needy. But her open ambition to rise above her current station rubs many of her coworkers the wrong way, especially the combative, street-smart Dawn (Amanda Goodwin) and the escort service's disdainful madam, Lucy (Ellen McElduff). (Drama) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Odd Jobs
5starmax.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
5starmax.us.description: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm. (Musical comedy) - 1964

5starmax.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
5starmax.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (Comedy drama) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
5starmax.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
5starmax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
5starmax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
5starmax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Night on Earth
5starmax.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Open Water
5starmax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

5starmax.us.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
5starmax.us.description: Sue Ellen Crandell is a teenager eagerly awaiting her mother's summer-long absence. While the babysitter looks after her rambunctious younger siblings, Sue Ellen can party and have fun. But then the babysitter abruptly dies, leaving the Crandells short on cash. Sue Ellen finds a sweet job in fashion by lying about her age and experience on her résumé. But, while her siblings run wild, she discovers the downside of adulthood. (Comedy) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Hoot
5starmax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Robin Hood
5starmax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Walk the Line
5starmax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
5starmax.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary) - 1970

5starmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
5starmax.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime drama) - 1999

backstage.us.description: When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge. (Drama) - 1997

Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible. (Crime drama, Action) - 2012

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers

When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
