After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
retroplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2017

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Badmen
retroplex.us.description: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. While both Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, the son wants to keep it for himself. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Texas Terror
retroplex.us.description: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: The Hawk of Powder River
retroplex.us.description: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Man From Oklahoma
retroplex.us.description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: The Navajo Kid
retroplex.us.description: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
retroplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2017

retroplex.us.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
retroplex.us.description: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. Eventually they find their way to the local sheriff, Blanco (David Keith), and begin to piece together the supernatural puzzle, which involves the dead rising from their graves. As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost. (Horror) - 2005

retroplex.us.title: Blackheart
retroplex.us.description: A con artist (Richard Grieco) leaves his partner for dead and pursues a woman (Fiona Loewi) with a $10 million inheritance. (Thriller) - 1998

retroplex.us.title: Played
retroplex.us.description: Rival gangs hire a British thug (Mick Rossi), who was imprisoned for eight years, to complete a hit in Los Angeles. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2006

retroplex.us.title: Flaming Bullets
retroplex.us.description: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: The Westward Trail
retroplex.us.description: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire
retroplex.us.description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Bar 20 Justice
retroplex.us.description: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine. (Western, Drama) - 1938

retroplex.us.title: Vengeance Valley
retroplex.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. (Western) - 1951

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S31 E25 Roxbury: Looking Back and Looking Ahead Angelo McRae shows Kevin how to install meshed white subway tiles for the kitchen backsplash; Kevin visits our Washington, D.C. project house; Tom Silva lends a hand with customizing and installing the stair treads and newel post for the new stairs.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S31 E26 Roxbury: One Less Foreclosure in Boston The job nears completion thanks to the dedication of general contractor David Lopes; Norm Abram and David reflect on how far the house has come in eight months; the team gathers for the wrap party.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E01 Auburndale: A Ho-Hum House on the Charles River Renovation begins on a 1940s house on Boston's famous Charles River; Tom conducts a structural investigation; Richard finds asbestos to be removed; Roger puts erosion control in place to protect the flood plain.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E02 Auburndale: Regulations and Challenges Removing old yews; demolishing a sun porch; a visit to the estate's original gatehouse; progress on excavation out front and back; a team of concrete cutters cuts through 10-inch-thick concrete foundation walls.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E07 Robotic Wall; Bench Ross Trethewey helps build a robotic wall that could be the key for tight space; Tom and Kevin use reclaimed pine heart wood to create a bench with a historic theme.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E08 Laundry; Table Saw Richard travels to Seattle to help a couple choose and install laundry appliances; Tom shows Kevin new table saw technology; Scott repairs a three-way switch.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E09 Microgreens; Elevator Kevin helps a contractor install a home elevator for a young man with disabilities; Jenn Nawada investigates how to grow microgreens; Tom explains the best way to match historic moldings; Richard diagnoses a problem with well water.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E10 Workshop; Light Switch Tom heads to Chicago to transform a one-car garage into a carpentry workshop; Scott installs a wireless light switch; Richard gives a history lesson on antique bath fixtures.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E11 Walkway; Mead; Wiring Roger rips up an old, dangerous walkway to replace it with bluestone; Scott explains the best wire nuts to use for each project; Kevin gets a lesson on making mead.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E12 Heating; Hand Saw; LED An environmentally safe way to keep walkways safe during the winter; showing how and when to use hand saws; helping a homeowner diagnose a problem with a hot water radiator; installing thin LED lights underneath the overhang of a homeowner's garage.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E13 Garden; Shed; Stains Landscape designer Jenn Nawada learns about rooftop and small space gardens; Tom explains the best practices to remove stains from plaster and drywall; Scott helps a homeowner power his shed by running electricity underground from his house.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E14 Future House; Offerman Kevin gets a firsthand look at Nick Offerman's woodworking shop; home technology expert Ross Trethewey looks at a new device to track home energy usage in Future House; Richard shows what happens when one uses the wrong soap in the dishwasher.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E15 NASA; Simulated Panels Tom is in Cincinnati to create a simulated wainscoting out of base cap molding; NASA astronaut Mike Foreman shows off a few space tools; Richard helps a homeowner get enough hot water for his children's bath time.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E16 Built It; Downlights Tom and Kevin use scrap wood to create an end grain cutting board in Build It; Scott installs surface-mounted downlights in a living room; What Is It?; Roger discusses the best ways to keep mice out of the house.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E10 Arlington Arts & Crafts: Shedding the Old Look The guys build an outdoor Yoga shed; on the main house, a standing-seam copper roof is installed over the front porch; Tommy trims a window using a PVC product with a rabbet joint; plumber Kevin Bilo installs a state-of-the-art boiler.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E11 Arlington Arts & Crafts: Underground Energy Removing a service pole at the front of the property; Norm helps Charlie build the flared porch columns; a new brick patio; the kitchen cabinets are delivered; the architect calls for decorative half timbers and stucco to accent the front gables.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E12 Arlington Arts & Crafts: Changes Start to Show Using pre-primed red cedar to shingle the house; a stylist helps figure out window treatments; radiant floor tubing is installed in the tracks under the existing old basement floor; repairing the grand living-room fireplace; repointing loose bricks.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E13 Arlington Arts & Crafts: Decorative Touches Make a Difference Assembling the roof on the ground; a lift helps raise the roof into place; the technique of Lazure painting, a watercolor style of painting interior walls; refinishing oak veneer; installing wood paneling in the living room; screening trees.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E14 Arlington Arts & Crafts: Shiplap for a Ship Shape House Tommy installs the shiplap; using reclaimed granite, Kevin helps Roger's crew lay a second set of steps for the walkway; Roberto finds and cuts a marble slab for the kitchen island; Mark builds the cast stone mantel surrounding for the new fireplace.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E15 Arlington Arts & Crafts: Details Make the House Beautiful Installing the marble in the kitchen island; laying the first giant stones for the fieldstone wall; hanging wallpaper over a secret door; how the radiant floor heating, air conditioning and supplemental heating system work; extra-large dog door.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E16 Arlington Arts & Crafts: An Arts & Craft for the Ages The Arts and Crafts house in Arlington is near completion and the guys come to take a last look and celebrate with the homeowners; touring the yard; Tommy and Norm check out the addition at the back of the house; touring the updated first floor.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E17 Detroit: Rebuilding Motor City Kevin introduces the city of Detroit; Kevin meets the homeowners for a tour of the first and second floor; Tommy is in the backyard, assessing some of the repairs needed; plumbing issues in the basement; suggestions for upgrading the electricity.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E18 Detroit: Ready for Rehab Kevin meets Detroit's Mayor to learn about the city's efforts to revitalize neighborhoods; Wes Kasperski installs an alarm system to keep the house protected during renovation; Frank works with Tommy and Kevin to blow in new insulation from the roof.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E19 Detroit: Peering Down the Rehab Rabbit Hole Richard checks the plumbing stack and Tommy investigates a leaky parapet; Kevin and Tommy work with Frank and his friends to demo the kitchen walls and investigate whether a beam is needed; a tree with a large root system threatens the foundation.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S38 E20 Detroit: Windows of Detroit Tommy teaches techniques to remove peeling paint in the living room while Richard and Frank begin rough plumbing repairs in the basement; Tommy shows Kevin the issues with the leaded stained-glass windows before restoration.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants a mix of white flowers in the writing garden, demonstrates how to prune a climbing rose and reviews what's been happening in the vegetable garden. Adam Frost celebrates seasonal colour on a visit to a garden in Essex, and Sue Kent pots up allium bulbs in readiness for spring and replants a tricky border with lavender she's grown from cuttings.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty harvests his loofahs, plants tulip bulbs in pots, gives a masterclass in making leafmould and reflects on the gardening year.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With Halloween approaching, Monty takes stock of his pumpkins and squashes, plants up alpines and shows how to divide a large fern to create new plants. Meanwhile, Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit Hever Castle in Kent.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

700407.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels from Missouri to Chicago and then across to New York and Philadelphia. He begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

700407.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
700407.description: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden where President Thomas Jefferson, one of America's founding fathers, enjoyed spending his time seeking out seeds and plants for his thousand foot vegetable garden.

700407.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
700407.description: Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team return with a celebration of spring. There's been plenty going on over the winter and lots of new projects in the garden to share. As well as getting on with some essential rose pruning, Monty plants clematis and rocket, cuts back grasses and makes a start on sowing annuals for colour this summer.

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-01-03

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.description: Martha Argerich spielt Ludwig van Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 und die Sinfonie Nr. 2 in D-Dur. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-07-02

classica.us.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
classica.us.description: Der belgische Dirigent Jos van Immerseel leitet Anima Eterna Brugge in einem Konzertprogramm, das dem amerikanischen Komponisten George Gershwin gewidmet ist. Die Aufführung wurde am 3. März 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-02-12

classica.us.title: Ravel - Sonate für Violine und Klavier in G-Dur
classica.us.description: Der japanische Geiger Naoya Nishimura und der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti interpretieren Maurice Ravels Sonate für Violine und Klavier (Nr. 2) in G-Dur, M. 77. Diese Aufführung wurde in der Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
classica.us.description: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können, weil man sie noch vor dem Stimmbruch kastriert. Die Dokumentation beschäftigt sich mit dem Aufstieg bekannter Kastraten in der Geschichte und den Umständen, die ihre Karriere möglich machten. Außerdem sprechen die zwei Kontratenoren Max Emanuel Cencic und Philippe Jaroussky über die Musikentwicklung im Barock. (Documentary, Music) - 2012

classica.us.title: Schumann - 3. Klaviersonate, Op. 14
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die dritte Klaviersonate, Op. 14 von Robert Schumann. (Special, Music) - 2023-11-14

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Zubin Mehta
classica.us.description: Der indische Dirigent Zubin Mehta wurde 1977 Musikdirektor des Israel Philharmonic Orchestra und 1981 zum Musikdirektor auf Lebenszeit ernannt. Als einer der weltweit führenden Interpreten der großen symphonischen Literatur hat Mehta dieses beliebte Meisterwerk unzählige Male dirigiert, aber es war das erste Mal, dass er es von Grund auf einstudiert hat. Ein intimer Blick wird auf den Dialog zwischen Mehta und den Mitgliedern des Orchesters geworfen, während sie Strauss' Tondichtung proben. (Music) - 2000-04-02

classica.us.title: Dvořák - Slawische Tänze, op. 46 (Nr. 1-8)
classica.us.description: Sir Simon Rattle dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in Antonín Dvořáks schwungvollen slawischen Tänzen, Op. 46 (Nr. 1-8). Diese Aufführung wurde am 23. September 2020 in St. Luke's in London, Großbritannien, aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Classical, Event) - 2025-10-11

classica.us.title: Schumann - Novelletten, op. 21
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Novelletten, Op. 21. Die acht Stücke für Klavier, die diesen Liederzyklus ausmachen, werden oft einzeln aufgeführt. Es trägt eine Widmung an den Pianisten Adolph Henselt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-01-23

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 1
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-04

classica.us.title: Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 und Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in diesem Konzert. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur, KV 338. Diese Sinfonie war die letzte, die Mozart in Salzburg als Hofmusiker schrieb. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-10-18

classica.us.title: Penderecki - Sinfonie 'Sieben Tore Jerusalems'
classica.us.description: Einer der größten Komponisten des späten 20. moviesphere.us.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me

(Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2018-08-02

(Comedy drama, Movie, Musical, Romance) - 2016-08-31

moviesphere.us.title: Red 2

outlaw.us.description: Part-Indian gunslinger Nevada (Cliff Potts) delivers explosives with his partner, Jonas Cord (Lorne Greene). (Western) - 1975

outlaw.us.title: Gun Glory
outlaw.us.description: Life is anything but sweet when roaming gunfighter Tom Early (Stewart Granger) returns home. His wife has died, and his son (Steve Rowland) now barely speaks to him. Things aren't much different in town, where Early tangles with the posse of a cattle baron (James Gregory) who vows to run a herd of 20,000 roughshod through the settlers' land. Early must somewhat reluctantly play the role of defender, especially after a foolhardy plan by the local preacher (Chill Wills) goes awry. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: The Burning Hills
outlaw.us.description: Cattle rancher Trace Jordan discovers the dead body of his brother and seeks out Joe Sutton, the cattle baron he knows killed him. Jordan kills Sutton in an act of self-defense during a shoot-out, but is also wounded and flees. He attempts to escape as Sutton's henchmen pursue him, and is soon joined by a half-Mexican woman named Maria, whose father had also been killed by Sutton. Eventually Sutton's men find them, and a confrontation occurs. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: The Train Robbers
outlaw.us.description: A proud widow hires a Civil War veteran to help recover the gold her late husband stole from Wells Fargo. (Western) - 1973

outlaw.us.title: The Hanging Tree
outlaw.us.description: Joseph "Doc" Frail (Gary Cooper) is a doctor with a past he's trying to outrun. While in Montana, he comes across a mining camp with a hanging tree and rescues a man named Rune (Ben Piazza) from the noose. With Rune as his servant, Frail decides to settle down, and he takes over as town doctor. He meets Elizabeth (Maria Schell), who is suffering from shock, and the two soon fall in love. But when Elizabeth is attacked, Frail's attempt to help her land them both in trouble. (Western) - 1959

outlaw.us.title: Mail Order Bride
outlaw.us.description: In late-19th-century Montana, Will Lane (Buddy Ebsen) is sent to look after unruly Lee (Keir Dullea), the son of a deceased pal. Lane hopes to find Lee a bride who'll tame him, so he selects a mail-order wife, Annie (Lois Nettleton). All goes according to plan, until carefree bachelor Lee makes a deal with Annie: he'll support her financially if she leaves him after the wedding. Annie agrees, but when Lee truly falls for his bride-to-be, he must choose between his lawless ways and settling down. (Western) - 1964

outtvproud.us.title: Sharknado
outtvproud.us.description: A monstrous storm devastates Los Angeles, leaving the streets flooded and infested with sharks. (Action, Thriller, Science fiction, Adventure, Comedy) - 2013

outtvproud.us.title: Flight 7500
outtvproud.us.description: A supernatural force terrorizes airline passengers. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

outtvproud.us.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
outtvproud.us.description: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Lord of Illusions
outtvproud.us.description: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix. (Horror) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: 10 Items or Less
outtvproud.us.description: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life. (Drama) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Lay the Favorite

outtvproud.us.title: Date and Switch

outtvproud.us.title: All Roads Lead to Rome

paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2011-02-18

thestandupchannel.us.title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
thestandupchannel.us.description: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
thestandupchannel.us.description: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Bob Saget: That's What I'm Talkin' About
thestandupchannel.us.description: Bob Saget takes to the stage with a filthy song in his heart as he lets loose and embraces the dark side as he tells his favorite dirty jokes and stories about his dad - the guy who made him like this.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Harland Williams: What a Treat
thestandupchannel.us.description: Stand-up comic Harland Williams takes center stage at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for a riotous evening of laughs; featured topics range from everyman observations on fingernails and fried food to musings on dating and the Pillsbury Doughboy.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty Sexy Funny
thestandupchannel.us.description: Female comedians Paula Bel, Tiffany Haddish, Lynne Koplitz, Justine Marino and Tammy Pescatelli join Jenny McCarthy to shed some light on what it's really like to be a woman.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Kevin Nealon: Whelmed but Not Overly
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic performs in Denver; topics include the fears, insecurities and doubts of parenthood.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Josh Gondelman: People Pleaser
thestandupchannel.us.description: Josh Gondelman performs in his debut special and the pressures of appearing in his friends' dreams.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Helen Hong: Well Hong
thestandupchannel.us.description: Standup comic Helen Hong recounts spending her COVID-19 quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and trying to teach the world that China is not the only country in Asia.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Nemr: No Bombing in Beirut
thestandupchannel.us.description: Filmed in Lebanon and America, the comic discusses his childhood in America and his later years in Lebanon.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
thestandupchannel.us.description: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
thestandupchannel.us.description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
thestandupchannel.us.description: From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Alonzo Bodden: Who's Paying Attention?
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic discusses the decline of civilization, the rise of pop culture, and swine flu.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jay Mohr: Altamont
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Jay Mohr tackles subjects ranging from unexpected visitors to bringing up children and working with Chris Farley on "Saturday Night Live."

thestandupchannel.us.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Keith Robinson Back of the Bus Funny
thestandupchannel.us.description: Keith Robinson describes the long-term dangers of being racist, the pitfalls of aging and the difference between the ways that men and women cheat.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Lavell Crawford: New Look Same Funny! (Extended Edition)
thestandupchannel.us.description: Lavell Crawford, with a new look and new outlook on life, hosts a new standup special.

truehistory.us.title: Ordinary Americans in the Revolution - Boycotting the Townshend Taxes
truehistory.us.description: A broad look at commerce in the pre-revolution American colonies. (American history) - 2022-06-08

truehistory.us.title: Ordinary Americans in the Revolution - Ebenezer Mackintosh: Stamp Act Protestor
truehistory.us.description: The story of Mackintosh, a shoemaker who led mass protests against the British. (American history) - 2022-06-08

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - A Meeting of Two Worlds
truehistory.us.description: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire
truehistory.us.description: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - The Interwar Period
truehistory.us.description: American interest in the Middle East between the wars; revealing one's focus shifting in the 1930s to American interest in Saudi Arabian oil; the increasing activism of American Zionism in response to Hitler's persecution of German Jews. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - U.S. & the Middle East During World War II
truehistory.us.description: United States' entry into World War II alters Americans' conception of the Middle East; the Middle East's geopolitical orientation is now seen as vital to American security. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Creation Stories and Why They Matter
truehistory.us.description: Considering the nature of creation stories. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
truehistory.us.description: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish
truehistory.us.description: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-15

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
truehistory.us.description: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity. (History, Documentary) - 2023-11-15

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion
truehistory.us.description: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
truehistory.us.description: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Arab Invasion of North Africa - 639
truehistory.us.description: The seventh-century Arab invasion of North Africa brings profound change to the entire region; the Arab armies of the newly created Islamic empire try to conquer the territories of Egypt and others; the lasting Arabization and Islamization. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Umayyad Caliphate in Damascus - 661
truehistory.us.description: The establishment of the Umayyad Caliphate's capital in Damascus is a key event in early Muslim history; the Umayyads' achievements; locating the empire's capital away from the Arabian Peninsula; the shift from an Islamic empire to imperial power. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
truehistory.us.description: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
truehistory.us.description: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon
truehistory.us.description: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi
truehistory.us.description: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything. (History) - 2022-07-15

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Anchorage, Alaska, a young mother and her two daughters were sexually assaulted and brutally murdered. There was only one piece of forensic evidence: a washrag carrying pubic lice that the killer used to clean himself after the crime. Employing an unusual and original method, an FBI expert combed through all the hairs and fibers in the apartment. He was not only able to determine how long each hair had been there, but which hairs came from the killer and how the crime proceeded.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise. But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham. Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft. But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers, two white and one black disappeared in Mississippi while passing through Neshoba County. A massive FBI investigation led to the recovery of the bodies of the slain men and physical evidence was recovered and analyzed. The FBI labs confirmed that all but one of the bullets used to kill the men came from the same gun. The FBI gained the trust of an informant, whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy. The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared. Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers. But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived. Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 26, 1993, an explosion rocked the World Trade Center parking garage. Six people died and more than a thousand were injured in the bomb blast that tore a 5-story crater in the building. During the investigation, the twisted fender of a rental van was extracted from the rubble. The FBI was able to determine from where the van was rented and by whom. Undercover agents then made their arrests within six days of the bombing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By December 1985, John Gotti had assumed his place as the new Don of the Gambino crime family in New York with the assassination of his boss, Paul Castellano. The Teflon Don felt secure in his position, always remaining one step ahead of the law. But he was also the ongoing obsession of Bruce Mouw, leader of an elite crew of FBI agents formed to bring down the Gambino family. With the help and genius of his Special Projects Squad, bugs were planted in Gotti's most private meeting places.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved. Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed. FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down. He was at home in the rugged terrain. But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home. The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings. Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Corruption in the New Orleans Police Department grew like a cancer in the early 1990's. Lured by the easy wealth of the narcotics industry, crooked cops began breaking the laws they were sworn to uphold. They would stop at nothing, including murder, to protect their rackets. When it became clear they could no longer police themselves, the FBI got involved. Putting their lives on the line, undercover agents devised a way to flush out the violent cops and restore trust in the city's police force.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed. When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged. The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear. Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president. With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics. Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children. The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

673498.title: The Kid From Broken Gun
673498.description: After years on the East Coast, former boxer Jack Mahoney (Jack Mahoney) returns to New Mexico and finds himself framed for murder. Though the only evidence is circumstantial, in the face of vicious prosecutor Kiefer (Myron Healey), Mahoney's girlfriend -- defense lawyer Gail Kingston (Angela Stevens) -- fails to convince the jury of his innocence. Determined to clear Mahoney's name, postal worker Steve Reynolds (Charles Starrett) transforms himself into the masked rider known as the Durango Kid.

673498.title: Men Without Law
673498.description: Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.

673498.title: Renegades
673498.description: Hannah Brockway (Evelyn Keyes) has a perfect fiancé in Dr. Sam Martin (Willard Parker). Sam, who is respected by Hannah's family, is a noble man who cares for her and can make a good living in their frontier town. Yet Hannah craves adventure and finds it when she meets dashing Ben Dembrow (Larry Parks), the youngest of a notorious crime family. Together Ben and Hannah set off to forge a new life, but prejudice and strangling family ties soon bring trouble to these newlyweds.

673498.title: The Great Sioux Massacre
673498.description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

673498.title: Masterson of Kansas
673498.description: In the 1870s, Marshal Wyatt Earp (Bruce Cowling) calls upon Dodge City, Kan., Sheriff Bat Masterson (George Montgomery) to track down rancher Merrick (John Maxwell), who is accused of murder. But, thanks to some proof held by local Native American Chief Yellow Hawk (Jay Silverheels), Masterson realizes Merrick might be the victim of a frame-up. So, with the help of Earp and gunfighter Doc Holliday (James Griffith), Masterson sets out to find those who are really behind the killing.

673498.title: Massacre Canyon
673498.description: A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.

673498.title: Return to Warbow
673498.description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

673498.title: Dirty Little Billy
673498.description: After his family moves to a frontier town in Kansas, city-bred teenager Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) finds he has no appetite for farming. He runs away, taking up with local outlaw Goldie (Richard Evans), who operates a saloon in town with the help of a prostitute named Berle (Lee Purcell). The three form a gang of sorts, menacing the locals until the townsfolk collectively decide to drive the outlaws away. Bonney escapes and begins the life of crime that makes him famous as Billy the Kid.

673498.title: Cripple Creek
673498.description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

673498.title: The Thrill Hunter
673498.description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

673498.title: The Nevadan
673498.description: After fleeing a sheriff's escort to jail, an outlaw thief crosses paths with a mysterious stranger and a greedy rancher en route to his stash of gold.

673498.title: Two Rode Together
673498.description: For a fee, hard-drinking Texas marshal Guthrie McCabe (James Stewart) agrees to help Army officer Jim Gary (Richard Widmark) search for a group of whites who were abducted years earlier by Comanche warriors. After rescuing two of the abductees, McCabe and Gary find that the former captives have fully adopted the culture of their American Indian captors and are barely recognizable. Cultures collide as they attempt to return the settlers to their original -- and now long-forgotten -- lives.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and his team chase down a bail jumper and he tries to help the criminal turn his life around with words of wisdom.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: In Hawaii, Dog sets off from Honolulu to Kona to help his son Leland with some of his fugitives. First, a stop at Leland's boxing gym to warm up for their day of hunting with a quick sparring session and some father-and-son time together.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: This one is close to home. Dog's target on today's hunt is the cousin of Kali, Garry Boy's caregiver. In addition she has a reputation as a brawler. With Duane Lee still missing from the team Baby Lyssa decides she will step-up in this hunt.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: In a last ditch attempt to bring the team back together, Dog recruits his pastor, Tim Storey, to be the peacemaker.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound or make it worse?

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a run away fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: When an alleged abuser goes on the lame Dog gathers the team to bring him in. As the leads grow colder Dog's determination only grows stronger. Finally a hot lead comes in and Dog sets the trap for his prey.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and company head to the Big Island in pursuit of two courthouse no-shows only to find that one of them appears to be posting status updates from Southern California.

400000088.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today the cameras are turned around.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Today's case involves a Samoan so Dog knows that the runner's close-knit kinfolk hold the keys to bringing him in.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: This fugitive's sketchy associates and footloose ways spell trouble for Dog in today's hunt.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog's target for today was once an upstanding member of his community. Now with no home, no job and the law on his trail, this middle-aged exile from middle-class society is using the cold end of an ice pipe to soothe his troubled soul.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and his team chase down a bail jumper and he tries to help the criminal turn his life around with words of wisdom.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog decides to liven things up with a competition. He and Beth will hunt for one fugitive, while Leland and Justin chase another.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Once a criminal himself, Dog knows how it feels to be hunted. In this episode of our series that focuses on the tumultuous home and professional life of bounty hunter Dwayne "Dog" Chapman.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: While hunting an elusive deep sea fisherman, Dog is also trying to plan a great Mother's Day for Beth, but he's having problems finding the special flowers Beth wants.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog is hunting a man known as "The Godfather of Waikiki". The bond is small, Dog and Beth bailed him out as a courtesy, but now he is refusing to go to court. If Dog doesn't bring him in, it could cost him more than money.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog has a big problem. Patty Estabilio has jumped a $15,000 bail bond and disappeared into Hawaii's underworld. Kissing the kids good night, Dog and Beth, with Tim and Leland at their side, plunge into a drug-infused netherworld.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Justin is the low man on the totem pole in the Chapman clan, and this means that the rest of the team is always teasing him.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog and his team return to their roots, with a visit to their home town of Denver, Colorado. Dog and Tim begin the day with an early morning radio show appearance, and it pays off.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Back in Denver Dog discovers that recapturing the past can be more difficult then tracking down felons. On a day of more misses then hits in their fugitive hunting, Dog and Beth repeatedly collide with reminders of their early days.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Working for a bondswoman friend, Mary Ellen, Dog and his team hunt Chris, a fugitive wanted on drug charges. Dog turns over every rock, but to no avail.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog goes after Virginia, a hard-to-find lawbreaker. He gets a tip that a pickup truck will be going to Virginia's house. In true private-eye fashion.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog decides to sweep the island clean of as many fugitives as he can in two days. Raymond, wanted on drug charges, is an easy grab. Mauro, wanted for solicitation, is busted.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog goes after a fugitive named Tracy who lives in a homeless shelter, but the shelter's staff is uncooperative, and the two sides get into an angry confrontation that forces Dog to temporarily back off.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
400000088.description: Dog juggles his job and family responsibilities at the same time. He leads the search for Robert, a low-level drug dealer who makes money by selling hedge clippings as marijuana and broken Macadamia nuts as crack.

724210.title: The Rifleman

724210.title: The Rifleman

724210.title: The Rifleman

724210.title: The Rifleman

724210.title: The Rifleman

724210.title: The Rifleman

673500.title: Twentieth Century
673500.description: When down-on-his-luck Broadway impresario Oscar Jaffe (John Barrymore) meets his discovery and former flame, Lily Garland (Carole Lombard), on the glamorous 20th Century Limited train between Chicago and New York, he uses every scheme at his disposal to win the movie star back both professionally and romantically. However, Lily, along with her new beau, George (Ralph Forbes), and Jaffe's rival producer, Max Jacobs (Charles Levison), who hired Lily to star in his latest play, have other plans.

673500.title: Don't Knock the Twist
673500.description: Dancers prepare for a TV special on the twist in this musical featuring performances of chart-topping hits from the heyday of rock 'n' roll.

673500.title: Good Neighbor Sam
673500.description: A happily married advertising agent helps out his single neighbor by posing as her husband so she can inherit a 15 million dollar fortune.

673500.title: The Awful Truth
673500.description: Jerry (Cary Grant) and Lucy (Irene Dunne) are a married couple who doubt each other's fidelity: Jerry suspects Lucy and her music teacher (Alexander D'Arcy) of spending an evening together, and Lucy is convinced Jerry lied about a business trip. When the jealous pair file for divorce, both rush into new relationships, but quickly realize their love never died. The soon-to-be-divorced husband and wife then both scramble to spoil each other's chances for newfound romance.

673500.title: The Magic Carpet
673500.description: When his parents, the caliph and queen, are murdered by usurper Ali (Gregory Gaye), the newborn Ramoth is delivered to the safety of his uncle, Ahkmid (William Fawcett), via a magic carpet. The adult Ramoth (John Agar) becomes masked hero the Scarlet Falcon. After tricking the reigning caliph into appointing him the royal physician, Ramoth learns of his noble birth and, with the help of faithful Razi (George Tobias) and beautiful Lida (Patricia Medina), he fights Ali and his wrathful minions.

673500.title: Born Yesterday
673500.description: Brassy blonde moll Billie Dawn (Judy Holliday) hits Washington, D.C., with her unscrupulous millionaire sugar daddy, Harry Brock (Broderick Crawford), and his sleazy lawyer, Jim Devery (Howard St. John), who has been pressuring Harry to marry Billie by pointing out that a wife cannot be forced to testify against her husband. In an effort to make Billie more socially acceptable, Harry hires journalist Paul Verrall (William Holden) to smarten her up -- and sparks soon fly between the pair.

673500.title: Bell, Book and Candle
673500.description: A Greenwich Village witch falls for her dashing neighbor. When she learns he’s engaged, she casts a love spell but risks losing her powers for good.

673500.title: Boots Malone
673500.description: A down-on-his-luck jockey's agent takes a wealthy, yet neglected kid under his wing, and, with the help of others, turns him into a champion.

673500.title: In Cold Blood
673500.description: Based on the book by Truman Capote.

673500.title: His Girl Friday
673500.description: A crafty editor for the Morning Post news uses every trick in the book to keep his fast-talking, ace reporter ex-wife from remarrying her new beau

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Farmer's New Pet; Spider Smurf
nick.uk.description: Farmer hires Willow's pet carnivorous plant to watch over his crops. Papa Smurf prepares a potion to boost his strength, but its effects are heavily altered due to a spider's intrusion.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - The Great Smurf Games - Part 2
nick.uk.description: Clumsy has got his heart set on taking part in the Great Smurf Games so that he can win the main prize: a magical sphere that grants one wish to the winner.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Smurfily Gmurfy; Smurf T for Thief
nick.uk.description: Baby Smurf finds Handy's cuckoo clock and ends up travelling through time. Chef Smurf must investigate when someone steals the festival cake.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Of Mice and Munks; Simon Saves the World
nick.uk.description: The Chipettes fall in love with a mouse that's doomed to be fed to a snake as part of a science class; Simon's new invention threatens to destroy the world.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Geizmo's Day Out; Unbored
nick.uk.description: Alvin gets a lesson in parenting after he kidnaps Simon's robot; when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Research & Development
nick.uk.description: With Baby Corp's stinkless serum in enemy hands, Turtleneck Superstar CEO Baby issues a challenge to deliver a new formula by 5 p.m.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Wrinkles & Stickles
nick.uk.description: After Turtleneck is captured by Frederic Estes, Boss Baby and Tim attempt to rescue her, leading them to the terrifying fun house at the town fair.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Rock's Half Birthday; Cherry Picking
nick.uk.description: Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true. Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry-picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Make Yourself Pat Home; Accidentally in Love
nick.uk.description: Patrick overstays his welcome at the SquarePants home. GrandPat attempts to injure himself for Nurse Helga's attention.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Single-Celled Defense; Buff for Puff
nick.uk.description: Plankton takes self-defence lessons from Sandy; Mr. Krabs hits the gym after a beach challenge from Larry.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Adventures in Babysitting; Alvin's Assistant
nick.uk.description: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting job with a spoiled four-year-old. Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.

nick.uk.title: The Creature Cases - The Puzzle of the Plummeting Eggs; The Missing Mole Rat Princess
nick.uk.description: Sam and Kit look for a mysterious bird who's messing with everyone's nest; the duo tracks down a royal mole rat who left her underground palace.

nick.uk.title: The Marsupilamis - Mission Park; Mar-Spooky-Lami
nick.uk.description: The Twins and Marsupilamis want to play in the park, but Rosa is guarding the entrance so they need to find another way in. Marcel sneaks into the Chahuta and the Marsupilamis give him a fright!

nick.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Kico the KittyCorn
nick.uk.description: On a rainy day, Gabby and friends must take care of Kico, a baby Kitty-Corn who is part kitty, part unicorn, until it's time for her to meet her family.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - Reaching for the Stars; Dream Team
nick.uk.description: After breaking Papa Smurf's telescope, Monkey wants to make up for his mistake by fetching him a star. Handy wants to assemble a team of experts to retrieve his jetpack from Gargamel, but the Smurfs he has in mind aren't available.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - The Party Animals / Warren Seville
nick.uk.description: Alvin books the band at a birthday party only to discover they've been booked for the petting zoo as pets; Theodore invents an imaginary friend.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Back to Basics; Report Cards
nick.uk.description: Everyone thinks Simon has lost his mind after he fails a school test and moves into a tree for some alone time. Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything he can to intercept the mail before Dave sees it.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - The Altruistic-Off; The Album
nick.uk.description: Rock, Paper and Scissors are three best friends who share a flat together and compete over everything. Week to week, they have tiny problems that always get out of hand.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Paper Takes the Phones; The Bedtime Story
nick.uk.description: Paper takes the cellphones of Rock and Scissors, so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever. Rock cannot sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he is hard to please.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Summer Chuseok; Putting up With the Plovers
nick.uk.description: In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.

nick.uk.title: Sonic Prime - Second Wind
nick.uk.description: To save Captain Dread's crew and recapture the Shard, Sonic will have to do what he does best: act fast. Luckily he has help from an unexpected ally.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Spoiler-Itis; Something Fishy
nick.uk.description: When Alvin is accused of revealing spoilers for everyone's favourite TV show, he agrees not to speak for 24 hours. When Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they go all out to replace it before he notices.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Kiss Conspiracy; House Guests
nick.uk.description: Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play; Alvin decides to rent out the family's house for a Hawaiian home swap.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Research & Development
nick.uk.description: With Baby Corp's stinkless serum in enemy hands, Turtleneck Superstar CEO Baby issues a challenge to deliver a new formula by 5 p.m.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Wrinkles & Stickles
nick.uk.description: After Turtleneck is captured by Frederic Estes, Boss Baby and Tim attempt to rescue her, leading them to the terrifying fun house at the town fair.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Emotional Support Convertible; The Baseball
nick.uk.description: Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car registered as an emotional support convertible and brings it with him everywhere. The trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Make Yourself Pat Home; Accidentally in Love
nick.uk.description: Patrick overstays his welcome at the SquarePants home. GrandPat attempts to injure himself for Nurse Helga's attention.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Nerds; The SquarePants Method
nick.uk.description: When Squidward sets out to prove that anyone can write a comic book, his work garners an obsessed fan base; an actor shadows SpongeBob in preparation for his next big movie, but his dedication to the role becomes a headache for SpongeBob.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Canyon Valley Film Festival/ Prison Break
nick.uk.description: Canyon Valley hosts a festival and Jack's excited to enter, until the pressure to deliver a masterpiece gets to him. When Jack and Lil are grounded by Will and Min, who are then grounded by Halmoni, the family team up to escape their punishment.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Prank You, Next
nick.uk.description: Max seeks help dealing with a mystery prankster at school from his old principal, who was always the target of his pranks.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Captain Jerk
nick.uk.description: Captain Man attempts to boost his image by holding a contest where three winners get a tour of his secret lair. But Henry's friends are among the winners.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - The Bucket Trap
nick.uk.description: Henry and Charlotte want to tell Jasper that Henry is really Kid Danger. They decide to give Jasper a test secret to prove he's ready.

nick.uk.title: Sam & Cat - YayDay
nick.uk.description: Cat invents a holiday, 'Yay Day', which is just an excuse to buy presents for everyone. When Cat snoops what other people have got her, she discovers an insulting present from Sam.

nick.uk.title: That Girl Lay Lay - The App Came Back
nick.uk.description: Lay Lay's avatar creator visits Sadie with some changes to the app settings, turning Lay Lay's personality negative, while Sadie tries to restore her best friend's positivity and convince the techie not to shut down the app completely.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans - Floral Support
nick.uk.description: Max uses Phoebe to help retrieve his chronicle of evil deeds from the school's confiscation closet but breaks her trust to pull off his plan.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans - Patch Me If You Can
nick.uk.description: Phoebe visits her boyfriend's shy brother, but the mild-mannered boy discovers his evil side when he gets his hands on one of Max's inventions.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Dream Busters
nick.uk.description: After being struck by a dream beam, Henry becomes stuck in a strange dream world. Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte try to find a way to wake him up and realise the only way to do this is if one of them goes into the dream to help him.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Kid Grounded
nick.uk.description: When Henry is caught sneaking out at night, he is grounded, keeping him from his crime-fighting duties. Piper drives him crazy at home and Charlotte becomes a sidekick.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Escape From Krinkle's
nick.uk.description: Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp, but he has to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom first; the field team strives to help him escape.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Puppy Party
nick.uk.description: A party in the park drags the Boss Baby into a dogfight with his old nemesis, Puppy Co.'s Bug the Pug, and the loser must don the "Collar of Shame."

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke; Scissors' Orchestra
nick.uk.description: Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke at a party and chase the feeling of people finding them funny by telling it again and again. Scissors hires an orchestra to follow him around and score his life.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - The Secret of Lake Island; Father, Son, and Furniture Store
nick.uk.description: Lil intros Jack to a deserted theme park: Lake Island; when they're stranded, their new friendship quickly crumbles; Will tries to connect with Jack at the oddball store Mike A's; everything goes awry and they must fight.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - LAD; Before 10am
nick.uk.description: Lil and her BFFs Anusha and Debs fight to win the coveted trophy at Hank n Beans arcade; determined to learn the truth about Jack's secret morning life, Lily does the unthinkable and wakes up early; her sleuthing gets them both in big trouble.
